fields.notes: While Friedrich Von Roehm and Harry Leland died during the battle with Nimrod in , both of them later unexplainably appeared in . In , Emma Frost gathered the Inner Circle to select a new Black Rook, because of "unfortune demise of Von Roehm", most likely meaning Friedrich. However, the story was seemingly set before Friedrich's death. Within same story Tessa stated that Von Roehms are one of the families, members of which inherited their positions in the Hellfire Club, The Club have an old tradition, "Right of Ancestry", that allows descendants to claim position that was once held by their ancestor. And indeed, years after Friedrich's death, Wolfgang von Roehm, presumably his relative, was mentioned as a member of the Club. So it is possible that Von Roehm mentioned in wasn't Friedrich, but his relative, and Friedrich inherited theirs Black Rook position. According to Selene, all high priests of her cult have "hereditary talents", "genetic switch" that she can activate to grant them powers, so presumably all previous high priests were members of Von Roehm family.

friendless.name: Friendless
friendless.origin: Born to a mother who bore children with a member of her species outside her caste, all but one of her eggs were destroyed by the ruling class as punishment. The one spared was believed to possess potential psychic capabilities, and was preserved. Sent to be taught in his abilities, he was dubbed "Friendless" and the teacher and other children were instructed to abuse him whenever possible. As he aged, his psychic powers gained him notoriety, but because of his breeding, he was deemed an abomination and sent to a distant space station. Once there, he took control of the Grad Nan Holt on the station, and secretly ruled them. At some point, the Shi'ar arrived, and Friendless took control of their commanding officers as well, then pitted the two sides against each other for his own amusement. When the Starjammers arrived on the station, he took control of all members save Marvel Girl, whose own psychic power prevented him from doing so. Temporarily falling into a coma, she was saved by Sovel Redhand and his band of pirates, and kept until the arrival of the X-Man Rogue. During this time, the Friendless set the Starjammers against Rogue's recently-arrived teammates. Arriving, Marvel Girl, Rogue, and the pirate band helped free the Shi'ar and Starjammers from his control, and Marvel Girl managed to force him though a breach in the space station's hull. Thought dead, he secretly made his way back aboard the station while the X-Men busied themselves with preventing it from falling into a nearby sun.

frigga.name: Frigga
frigga.origin: ===Origin=== Frigga or Frigg, was the daughter of the Vanir leader Freyr. At some point in the Ragnarök cycles, she seemingly had the role of guardian of Hel. ===Aesir/Vanir War=== At some point, Odin Borson, ruler of the Aesir, decided that the Aesir and the Vanir would unite as one tribe, no matter the cost, and imposed an ultimatum. While Freyr comforted his daughter with promises of peace, he went to Surtur and obtained his help against the Aesir, answering to Odin's death with war. ===Peace=== After years of war, Odin proposed to marry Frigga, establishing a truce. When they finally married, the Vanir joined with the Aesir to become the Asgardians and Frigga was appointed goddess of marriage. For the Vanir and Aesir to be truly united, an heir originated from the wedlock was to be produced, in the person of Aldrif. Later she gave birth to their firstborn son Tyr. ===War of Angels=== When Heven waged war on Asgard, the Queen of Angels kidnapped Frigga's first born daughter Aldrif in an attempt to blackmail Odin into surrendering. He refused, and the Queen seemingly killed Aldrif before fleeing. Following this event, Odin used his powers to cut Heven from the other Nine Realms and Yggdrasil. In retaliation for what the Queen of Angels had done, Frigga sought the Norns to struck a deal with them and cast a curse upon the Angels of Heven. Upon their deaths, their souls would be given to Hela to punish them eternally. Unbeknown to the Asgardians, Aldrif was still alive and was raised as one of the Angels under the name of Angela. Deprived from Aldrif, the Gods thought that no true heir had ever been produced, and the Vanir/Aesir union remained unstable. While Odin dealt with it, Frigga had more trouble, and consequently refused to try again to produce an heir (she stated she hadn't any children of her own, explaining why she had more trouble than Odin to overcome the event). ===Balder=== Sometimes later, she gave birth to Balder. An ancient Asgardian prophecy foretold Balder's death would initiate an apocalyptic event called Ragnarök which would herald the death of all Asgardians. However, Odin feared that if Balder were known to be his son it would make him a target and hasten Ragnarök; consequently, Balder was brought up unaware of his royal lineage. ===Thor and Loki=== She raised her husband's son Thor, the god of thunder, though he was not her natural son. After the war Asgard and Jotunheim, Odin adopted Loki, son of King Laufey and he asked Frigga to raise him as her own child. ===Third Host=== Around 1000 AD, the Council of Godheads confronted the Third Host of the Celestials, who announced they would return in a thousand years to judge if Earth was worthy of existence. While the gods planned to wage war against the Celestials, the Earth goddess Gaea gathered Frigga, Sigyn and goddesses of other pantheons to locate humans across a span of a thousand years and release the latent genetic potential buried within them since the First Host. These superhumans, called the Young Gods, were intended to show the Celestials the greatness humanity could achieve. ===Modern Day=== ====Fourth Host==== The Young Gods were kept in suspended animation, watched over by Frigga and others. When the Celestials finally returned to judge humanity, Frigga relinquished the Young Gods to Gaea and returned to Asgard. In turn, Gaea offered the Young Gods to the Celestials, satisfying them of Earth's value. thumb|right ====Surtur War==== During "the Surtur War" against the Fire Demon Surtur, Frigga fled from Asgard with the Asgardian children under her protection. She returned to Asgard after Surtur's defeat, only to find her husband had fallen in battle. They were later reunited when Thor rescued Odin from the Egyptian death god Seth. ====Lost Gods==== Odin later attempted to prevent Ragnarok by casting the Asgardians into mortal forms, with no memories of their true lives. Odin became the drunken derelict Wad, and Frigga was cast as his wife Freda Barker. The "Lost Gods" were eventually restored to godhood with their memories. ====Ragnarök==== Loki slew Balder with a mistletoe arrow, accomplishing the prophecy of Ragnarok, and leading to the realm's ultimate destruction. Frigga was killed in the following steps of Ragnarok. However, Thor survived and enabled those Asgardians who fell during Ragnarok to return to life, including Frigga. ====The All-Mother==== At some point after her return, Frigga formed a triad of goddesses with Gaea and Idunn known as the All-Mother. Following the disaster of The Serpent's attack on Asgard, Odin summoned the All-Mothers to assume control in his absence. When King Loki allied with Hela and resurrected Jormungand to attack Asgardia, the All-Mother sacrificed her own life to banish the Midgard Serpent back to Hel. Freyja then traveled to Valhalla where she informed the fallen that Odin had sounded the Gjallarhorn allowing the heroes of the past to be reborn and return to fight in the new Ragnarök.

fritz bruck.name: Fritz Bruck
fritz bruck.origin: Fritz Bruck was a member of the Nazis active during World War II. By the fall of 1943, he was part of a group of Nazi spies who were active in the United States operating out of Chicago. With war rationing making commodities scarce and expensive, the Nazis decided to use the black market to further their ends. With black market meat becoming a booming business, they begun selling tainted beef in the hopes of lowering American morale and making factory workers ill in order to set back the war effort. After a family of six died from eating the tainted beef, the Human Torch and Toro decided to investigate. They tracked down the supply of the tainted beef to the slaughter house in which Fritz and his men operated from. When confronting the spies, Fritz set off an explosive and fled to the abandoned train yard where the Nazis brought in their tainted beef. The Torch and Toro followed Fritz there, and using their flame powers began setting the diseased cattle on fire. The resulting stampede found Fritz and his cohorts trampled to death, while the cattle were incinerated.

fritz harden.name: Fritz Harden
fritz harden.origin: Fritz Harden was a member of the Miami Arts Comission whom Mary Morgenstern convinced to let Scott Lang audition so his company Ant-Man Security Solutions could handle the security for the biggest museums and performing artists centers in the city. They met up in a museum, and Mr. Harden turned out to be a big fan of super heroes, including Ant-Man himself. However, Whirlwind, who was targeting Ant-Man, attacked the museum and caused severe damage. When the fight ended, Harden changed his opinion on super heroes after witnesing a fight live and up close, and cut off the deal.

fritz kalb.name: Fritz Kalb
fritz kalb.origin: One of Max Eisenhardt's teachers growing up. He warned Max that standing out would lead to him being beaten down. Kalb was fired from his teaching post as the Nazis began their discrimination against Jewish citizens and he later ended up at Auschwitz. Meeting his former pupil there, Kalb helped him as best as he could to survive, trying to get him assigned to the Kanada Kommando, those who sorted the belongings of the new arrivals, he accidentally got him assigned to the , the detail that was forced to aid the Nazis in the various methods of killing Jewish prisoners. It was while doing this job that Max sighted Fritz's corpse on a conveyor belt that led to the cremation chamber.

fritz klaw.name: Fritz Klaw
fritz klaw.origin: ===Early Life=== Colonel Fritz Klaue was of Dutchman living in Belgium, he however left to join the Nazis in Germany. He became a high ranking commander and enemy of the Howling Commandos. He lost his hand during the war and had it replaced with a steel replica. ===WWII=== He was was put in command of Festung von Furcht, where they developed the jet plane known as the Thunderer. The base was however attacked by Sgt. Nick Fury and the Howlers. Klaue tried to stop them reaching the plane but he failed. He tried to crush Fury with his steel hand but was ultimately defeated. ===Wakanda=== Klaue led a mission to Wakanda in Africa to regain Adolf Hitler favor. His plane however crashed leaving him as the only survivor. Klaue was nursed back to health by the chieftain Black Panther (Chanda). He befriended the king and was amazed by the hidden Wakandans, and the Great Mound of Vibranium. Klaue had the Wakandans build the Panther Idol icon, demanding that they worship it as a god instead of a brother spirit. When the panther refused, he tried to kill him murdering the queen Nanali instead. Panther escaped into the jungles, but when he returned, he defeated Klaue and ripped his steel hand off, causing him to flee back to Germany. ===Blitzkrieg Squad=== Klaue took command of the Blitzkrieg Squad after the disappearance of Baron Wolfgang von Strucker. He was ordered by Hitler to assassinate the prime minister Winston Churchill when he was due to present a medal to Sgt Fury. When the squad made their attempt, the spy Nina Bergson took a bullet for Churchill. Klaue and the squad were then taken down by the Howlers. Klaue collaborated with Gerta Heinz to detonate a bomb beneath a London pub run by a collaborator named Alfie where the Howlers were taking a furlough. They captured Percival Pinkerton and tied him up beneath the pub, but he managed to escape and get the other Howlers out of the building before it exploded. Klaue tried to break his squad out of custody to help him. Klaue led the squad in destroying a number of munitions depots in England. Klaue took Captain "Happy Sam" Sawyer himself captive, but had to face the commandos, Bull McGiveney's Maulers, and Jim Morita's Nisei Squadron. Just as Klaue was about to broadcast Sgt. Fury's death over the radio to Hitler, he was shot by Dum-Dum Dugan. Dugan's bullet only grazed Klaue's left cheek, giving him a scar, but it incapacitated him long enough for the Howlers to apprehend him. He and the Blitzkrieg Squad were placed in the base's stockade. Klaue had the scientist Dr. Enderle modify his steel fist so that it contained a new assortment of weaponry. He convinced Hitler to give him another chance and sent a radio broadcast to Fury daring him to face him in combat aboard a Swiss ship actually a Nazi ship in disguise. Instead of Fury, Dum-Dum Dugan arrived and managed to hold his own against Klaue until the other Howlers came to assist him, and Klaue was once again defeated. He moved to the United States of America, and plotted against the Fury family. When Fury came home on leave, Klaue moved in and captured him and had him drugged. The commandos managed to rescue Sgt. Fury, but he too his sister Dawn Fury hostage. He rendezvoused with Von Stuerer, head of American espionage for the Nazis, but Klaue, Von Stuerer, and all of their men were defeated with the help of Jake Fury. ===Ulysses Klaw=== After the war, Klaue moved to Belgium and later anglicized his name to "Klaw" and raised his son Ulysses Klaw with tales of Wakanda. He died never living his dreams of returning and conquering Wakanda for the vibranium. Ulysses later invaded Wakanda himself for the vibranium.

Fury's death over the radio to Hitler, he was shot by Dum-Dum Dugan. Dugan's bullet only grazed Klaue's left cheek, giving him a scar, but it incapacitated him long enough for the Howlers to apprehend him. He and the Blitzkrieg Squad were placed in the base's stockade. Klaue had the scientist Dr. Enderle modify his steel fist so that it contained a new assortment of weaponry. He convinced Hitler to give him another chance and sent a radio broadcast to Fury daring him to face him in combat aboard a Swiss ship actually a Nazi ship in disguise. Instead of Fury, Dum-Dum Dugan arrived and managed to hold his own against Klaue until the other Howlers came to assist him, and Klaue was once again defeated. He moved to the United States of America, and plotted against the Fury family. When Fury came home on leave, Klaue moved in and captured him and had him drugged. The commandos managed to rescue Sgt. Fury, but he too his sister Dawn Fury hostage. He rendezvoused with Von Stuerer, head of American espionage for the Nazis, but Klaue, Von Stuerer, and all of their men were defeated with the help of Jake Fury. ===Ulysses Klaw=== After the war, Klaue moved to Belgium and later anglicized his name to "Klaw" and raised his son Ulysses Klaw with tales of Wakanda. He died never living his dreams of returning and conquering Wakanda for the vibranium. Ulysses later invaded Wakanda himself for the vibranium.

fritz krone.name: Fritz Krone
fritz krone.origin: During the Second World War, Fritz Krone developed robotic drone soldiers that could have changed the face of the war. Hitler, however, underestimated the value of Krone's creations, choosing instead to send an entire generation of young German men to their deaths. left|thumb|Fritz Krone in 1942 Instead, Hitler used Krone as a Nazi Fifth Columnist that was active during World War II. By the summer of 1942 he was sent to New York City where he and his spy network rabble roused to demoralize the population into giving up on the war effort. Further to this plot, they had also built a secret underground base near the digging of a subway tunnel. Using props to make them look like strange "Earthmen", they attack the people of New York further ruining the morale of the people. thumb|left|One of Krone's "Earthmen" This plot was investigated by Captain America, Bucky, and Betty Ross. Cap and Bucky exposed the secret tunnel and had it destroyed. Then battling Krone one-on-one in front of the public, Captain America swiftly beat the Nazi with his bare hands. His true cowardliness exposed, Krone begged Captain America to allow him to surrender and was taken into police custody. It is unknown how Krone got out of prison, but by 1959, he was working as an operative of ICON alongside many other Nazi war criminals. He was part of the group that accompanied General Skul on an assault of Wakanda in order to pillage the secret African nation's highly advanced technology. He was knocked unconscious by Powell McTeague when they were attacked by Nick Fury's Avengers. Apparently, his robots required a mental connection to Krone as they ceased functioning once he was knocked unconscious. What became of him afterwards is unknown.

fritz mueller.name: Fritz Mueller
fritz mueller.origin: Fritz Mueller was a spy for the Nazis during World War II. By 1944, he was living in the United States under the cover of a pitcher for the New York Blue Sox baseball team. In the spring of that year, he was sent to assist in the capture of an American soldier who learned of a plot by the Imperial Japanese Army to blast loose icebergs in the North Pacific to flow down and crush Allied convoys. He made the mistake of dropping his lucky rabbit's foot at the scene of the crime. When Toro, a devout baseball fan, learned of this from the authorities, he suspected Mueller of being responsible. He captured him in the middle of a baseball game and brought him to police headquarters where they were able to get the information out of him. His subsequent fate is unknown.

fritz sablinov.name: Fritz Sablinov
fritz sablinov.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 8
fritz sablinov.origin: Fritz Sablinov was the twin brother of Ernst Sablinov, a Nazi hunter from Symkaria who formed a military unit to hunt Nazi war criminals commanded by himself after 1959. Ernst married Anastasia and had a daughter, Silvija; meanwhile, Fritz also had a daughter, Anna Sablinova, who was younger than Silvija. As Fritz and Ernst were indistinguishable even to their families, they shared command of the Wild Pack, with Fritz replacing Ernst in a number of public situations: Sometimes, when Ernst went undercover in missions, Fritz pretended to be Ernst in front of the Wild Pack. While Ernst was an excellent fighter, Fritz was a better tactician and strategist, often preparing the missions for the Wild Pack, and both were known to participate in the management of the Wild Pack, as Fritz's existence and work were not a secret. Although Fritz carried out his job efficiently, Fritz was jealous of Ernst because Ernst, not Fritz, was leading the Pack, and Ernst knew it. thumb|left|Teaching a young Silvija Sablinova Soon after the creation of the Wild Pack, Anastasia was killed by Nazi war criminal Ivan Trefkov, who became Ernst's personal nemesis. Shortly after, Ernst began training his daughter Silvija to join the Pack. Sometimes, Fritz would train her while Ernst participated in missions. Silvija joined the Wild Pack, and became second-in-command to Ernst, or so she believed since she did not know of her father's close collaboration with Fritz. In the following years, Fritz mysteriously disappeared, apparently to devote himself exclusively to being Ernst's double. Ernst had at least two heart attacks, and both Silvija and Anastasia's brother, Morty, urged Ernst to leave active command of the Wild Pack; Morty advised Ernst to adopt Fritz's personality traits, but Ernst insisted that they should not even think about Fritz. When Trefkov reappeared working for the neo-Nazi criminal organization Hydra, Ernst and Silvija wanted to take the opportunity to avenge Anastasia; Ernst also wanted to destroy Hydra. In the operation, however, Trefkov stabbed Ernst, apparently killing him, and escaped with Ernst's body. Really, Trefkov had kidnapped Ernst and kept him alive to use him as a living battle computer, connecting him to advanced Hydra technology to take advantage of Ernst's tactical genius; Ernst tried to sabotage this effort by focusing his mind for years on gambits that he knew were destined to fail. thumb|Captured by Hydra and tortured by Trefkov As Fritz was missing at that time, Silvija became the sole legal guardian of Fritz's daughter Anna. Anna was immediately sent to a boarding school in Long Island. Fritz discreetly attended his brother's funeral, but established a plan based on the fact that Ernst's body had not been found and was apparently in Trefkov's hands. Fritz posed as Ernst to attack a Hydra outpost, attempting to attract Trefkov's attention to find out what exactly had happened. Fritz expected to be captured by Hydra during the attack, and so he was; but when his captors saw that he was apparently Ernst, they brought him before Trefkov, again following Fritz's plan. For months, Trefkov had Fritz tortured, without revealing where Ernst's body was. In his ordeal, Fritz developed an extreme plan to try to destroy Hydra, and presented it to Trefkov: The creation of a faction called Genesis Coalition that would steal assets from Hydra, waiting for the moment to destroy them and take their place, when in reality Fritz's plan was to provoke a civil war that would destroy both organizations. Trefkov however was convinced by the plan and supported Fritz, after which Trefkov personally convinced a former faction of Hydra to form the Genesis Coalition. For years, Fritz remained deeply undercover in Hydra and the Genesis Coalition. Within Hydra and the Genesis Coalition, Fritz Sablinov's identity was known, as he was believed to have deserted from the Wild Pack. At a time when Hydra was especially weakened following the death of Strucker, the Coalition took advantage to openly secede before Strucker resurrected and reorganized Hydra, opposed by the Genesis Coalition. Becoming a Hydra splinter group, the Genesis Coalition was persecuted by Strucker, who branded them traitors. thumb|In Genesis Coalition uniform. Fritz Sablinov and a large group from the Genesis Coalition, including Trefkov, acquisition specialist Dmitri Petrovich, and geneticist Franz Lubischt, established a secret base hidden behind a waterfall in the lush rainforest of South America, with multiple low-level agents and scientists at their command. The Genesis Coalition captured humans and animals to subject them to very painful experiments in an attempt to create extraordinarily powerful hybrid super-soldiers, with support from international investors and advanced equipment stolen from Hydra. fields.personality: thumb|left|In the Genesis Coalition, he was the voice of reason mediating between Trefkov and Petrovich. As a member of the Wild Pack, Fritz was dedicated to his job of pursuing war criminals, although he was always jealous of his beloved brother Ernst for his leadership of the unit. He was willing to make any personal sacrifice for his missions, including his family life. During the torture, he set up a plan to destroy Hydra in which he also sacrificed his principles. After years undercover in the Genesis Coalition, Fritz lost his mind and began developing insane plans, causing wars if he deemed necessary while torturing his own brother. He attempted to hold on to what little was left of his humanity by having the Coalition torturing the subjects of their experiments as little as possible and stopping conflicts between the highest-level members, being the most level-headed person in the Coalition leadership. However, when his niece scuttled his plans, Fritz was willing to kill her while blaming her for the disaster.

fields.notes: Slavic surnames have for males and females. Sablinova is a female surname, so would be appropriate for e.g. Silver Sablinova, but the correct form of the name for a man would be Sablinov. Since he is the twin brother of Silver Sable and has a relatively young daughter of his own, this creates some questions as the Sliding Timescale of Earth-616 makes it difficult for Fritz to have a daughter who is in her relative prime in the Modern Age. As yet, there are no official explanations available. However, due to Ernst's associations with Nick Fury and Sergei Kravinoff, two men who have found artificial means of slowing the aging processes, the idea that Ernst maintained vitality by a similar method is reasonably plausible, and as Fritz had impersonated Ernst with the latter's blessing, whatever Ernst used was probably shared with Fritz. says that Trefkov (written "Trefkoff") was the leader of the Genesis Coalition. (Silver Sable's profile), while describing the same events, says that Fritz Sablinov was the leader of the Genesis Coalition. thumb|Fritz's moustache should be clearly seen in his first appearance with his armor, as it was seen in his later appearances. Fritz was first seen with his armor in during the Cyberwar story arc. The armor shows his lower face and unambiguously shows him without his trademark handlebar moustache. Further uses of the armor in and prove that the moustache should have been seen. His hair color, including the moustache, changes from white (or silver) to gray between panels in the same scene in (Silver Sable's profile) says that Fritz did "electronically stripmine" his brother' Ernst's mind for its tactical genius and kept him under his watch. Per to , Trefkov took Ernst's body and, per , at least several months passed between that moment and Fritz becoming an undercover Hydra agent (Because, after Ernst's funeral, Fritz was captured by Hydra and was tortured for months). It is unclear what happened with Ernst during these months and why Trefkov kept him alive in the first place, if it was not Trefkov's plan to keep Ernst alive as a living computer.
fields.trivia: Fritz is known to have a daughter, Anna, and after Fritz's disappearance and Ernst's apparent death, Silvija was Anna's closest relative and tutor. Anna's mother's identity is not revealed, and it is unclear whether Fritz was a widower, divorced her or even married her at any point. Fritz disappeared for many years. He reappeared as a criminal and was killed, something known by Silver Sable, the Wild Pack and the Foreigner. It is unclear whether any of them told Fritz's daughter Anna.

fritz sternberg.name: Fritz Sternberg
fritz sternberg.origin: The Black Claw was a notorious Nazi naval leader who was active during World War II. He was feared even among his crew members, whom he shot dead for failing in any given task. He was responsible for sinking American convoy and patrol ships in the later end of 1941. His activities prompted playboy Dan Kane to revive his Spanish War costumed identity of Captain Terror. Captain Terror attacked his ship while it engaged with US forces, leading to his ship being sunk, however the Black Claw managed to escape into the United States. Captain Terror followed the Black Claw back to his hideout where he was captured. The Black Claw took terror aboard his new ship and showed him the new Nazi invention: magnetic mines, which he intended to use against the United States. Captain Terror broke free and set a bomb to go off aboard the Black Claws ship. Battling Black Claw, the two were knocked overboard, where Captain Terror forced the Black Claw under water, seemingly drowning him while his ship exploded.

fritz tiboldt.name: Fritz Tiboldt
fritz tiboldt.origin: Fritz Tiboldt was a German citizen that ran his own circus (Tiboldt's Circus) in the 1940s. He was hired by the Nazis to travel to America. There, under the guise of a legitimate circus, he and his circus performers used their unique abilities to eliminate U.S. military officials. Each night, Fritz selected their targets with his "Wheel of Death", sending out his best suited operatives to carry out the job. Among his circus members were the midget Tommy Thumb (an unwitting accomplice who was forced into servitude with threats of violence), Omir the snake charmer, Zandow the strong man, the Trapeze Trio, and others. When the circus set up near Camp Lehigh, Fritz first targeted General Blaine. When Blaine attended the circus, Fritz forced Tommy to let loose one of the tigers to attack him. Blaine was mauled to death by the tiger, which was in turn slain by Captain America. Captain America happened to be on the scene in his civilian guise of Steve Rogers with his sidekick, Bucky Barnes. Although suspecting foul play, Captain America and Bucky had no proof and decided to keep an eye on the circus. Tiboldt's next target was Commissioner Newsome, and Tiboldt send Omar and the Trapeze Trio to eliminate him. His murder was witnessed by Betsy Ross, and despite Captain America and Bucky's interference, she was captured by the circus members. Tracing her back to the circus, Captain America and Bucky beat the Circus into submission, freed Betsy, and defeated the Ringmaster. Following his return to Germany, Fritz and his wife were killed for their failure. === Legacy === Fritz was survived by his descendant, Maynard, who continued running the circus in the Modern Age.
fritz tiboldt.bio: Fritz Tiboldt was a German citizen that ran his own circus (Tiboldt's Circus) in the 1940s. He was hired by the Nazis to travel to America. There, under the guise of a legitimate circus, he and his circus performers used their unique abilities to eliminate U.S. military officials. Each night, Fritz selected their targets with his "Wheel of Death", sending out his best suited operatives to carry out the job. Among his circus members were the midget Tommy Thumb (an unwitting accomplice who was forced into servitude with threats of violence), Omir the snake charmer, Zandow the strong man, the Trapeze Trio, and others. When the circus set up near Camp Lehigh, Fritz first targeted General Blaine. When Blaine attended the circus, Fritz forced Tommy to let loose one of the tigers to attack him. Blaine was mauled to death by the tiger, which was in turn slain by Captain America. Captain America happened to be on the scene in his civilian guise of Steve Rogers with his sidekick, Bucky Barnes. Although suspecting foul play, Captain America and Bucky had no proof and decided to keep an eye on the circus. Tiboldt's next target was Commissioner Newsome, and Tiboldt send Omar and the Trapeze Trio to eliminate him. His murder was witnessed by Betsy Ross, and despite Captain America and Bucky's interference, she was captured by the circus members. Tracing her back to the circus, Captain America and Bucky beat the Circus into submission, freed Betsy, and defeated the Ringmaster. Following his return to Germany, Fritz and his wife were killed for their failure. === Legacy === Fritz was survived by his descendant, Maynard, who continued running the circus in the Modern Age.

fritz von arnheim.name: Fritz von Arnheim
fritz von arnheim.origin: thumb|left|149px|Fritz von Arnheim unmasked Fritz von Arnheim was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. He gained notoriety as being one of the FBI's most sought after spies. In 1944, he took over the home of and posed as Civil War veteran Herman the Hermit who lived along the Mississippi River near a concentration camp where Nazi prisoners of war were kept. Fritz helped break out Nazi agents and led raids on the concentration camp to free his comrades. His activities gained the attention of the Human Torch and Toro who were taking a trip down the river. The Torch and Toro traveled to Herman the Hermit's home to apprehend Herman but were tricked into flying into a vacuum sealed room. When Fritz and his minions left to make another attack on the concentration camp. The Torch and Toro were freed by the real Herman the Hermit who assisted the Torch and Toro in capturing the escaped Nazi spies. When Fritz attempted to escape in a car, the Torch forced him to crash. He was unmasked and then turned over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

fritz von bock.name: Fritz von Bock
fritz von bock.origin: thumb|left|Fritz von Bock disguised as Dr NoonFritz von Bock was a member of the Nazis during World War II. In the spring of 1943 he and his gang of spies worked within the United States to steal government secrets. To this end, he took the place of Doctor C.J. Noon. With the doctor's credentials he quarantined members of the science and defense sectors in order to steal secret designs and formulas. By keeping the authorities out with fear of contracting smallpox, he managed to eliminate his targets and steal their secrets. When he attempted to do so at the home of Colonel Tarley, the screams from Tarley's wife attracted the attention of the Angel. Turned away because of the quarantine notice and policeman on the door, the Angel instead began to track down Dr. Noon, who supposedly signed off on the notice. He went to check on the doctor at his office and found the real Dr. Noon chloroformed in his closet. Von Bock and his men then walked in on the hero and Nazi spy used his cunning to beat the Angel. They tied him and Dr Noon up and went to steal the Hall Rapidfire Gun invented by Mr James Hall. The Angel broke free and stopped Fritz von Bock before he could torture the secret out of Hall. With Von Bock defeated, he was unmasked and turned over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

fritz von meyer.name: Fritz von Meyer
fritz von meyer.species: Human Mutate; (spirit and skeleton surrounded by Mutant Bees )
fritz von meyer.origin: ===Early Life=== Fritz von Meyer was born in Leipzig, Germany in the early 20th century. A brilliant scientist with a Ph.D. in both toxicology and entomology, he became a fervent supporter of the Nazi regime during World War II. Throughout the conflict, Von Meyer stole vast quantities of gold from numerous European capitals, hiding the treasure for his personal gain. An accomplished apiculturist, he also conducted extensive research into insect-derived toxins, aiming to adapt them for use in chemical warfare. ===Post-War Years=== Following the war, Von Meyer used his stolen fortune to escape prosecution, fleeing to South America. There, he lived as an expatriate Nazi scientist deep in the jungle, working in isolation. Despite his efforts to remain hidden, Interpol began tracking former Nazi war criminals and eventually dispatched agent Robin Callahan to investigate his whereabouts. During his time in the jungle, Von Meyer devoted himself to the study of killer bees and their breeding habits. His research took a dramatic turn when he discovered an enormous hive of unusually passive bees, unlike any species previously documented. He learned that a recent meteor shower had bombarded the region with radiation, which he theorised had caused a mutation in the insects. Further experimentation revealed that the cosmic exposure had enhanced their intelligence a thousandfold. Convinced that these mutated bees could be used to conquer the world, Von Meyer returned to his laboratory and developed a psionic frequency beam intended to manipulate the hive's behaviour. However, when he activated the device, the bees attacked him instead of obeying. In a last effort to save himself, he managed to psionically enslave the queen bee but not before the swarm consumed his body. Although his physical form was destroyed, Von Meyer's consciousness survived within the hive, preserved by a unique mental cohesion field. The bees incorporated his skeleton into their structure, forming a humanoid body controlled by his mind. Now a living swarm with a collective intelligence, he named himself Swarm and began plotting world domination. ===Rise of Swarm=== Swarm constructed several giant mechanical bees, which he could control through his mental connection to the hive, using them in his campaign for conquest. However, Interpol eventually located him again. Agent Callahan stole the queen bee and encased her in amber, severing Von Meyer's control over the hive. To restore his power, Swarm travelled to the United States in pursuit of Callahan. Swarm tracked Interpol agent Callahan to the Santa Monica harbor, where he unleashed his giant mechanical bees in an attempt to kill him. The agent's screams drew the attention of nearby Champions, who were at the docks to bid farewell to their friend Ivan Petrovich. As the Champions engaged the mechanical bees, Swarm personally intervened and killed Callahan using the bees that made up his own body. He then attempted to retrieve the briefcase Callahan had been carrying, only to discover it was sealed with a powerful insect repellent that rendered him unable to open it. Swarm was forced to retreat, taking his mechanical bees with him. The Champions recovered Callahan's body and the briefcase, unwittingly making themselves Swarm's next target. Determined to reclaim the queen bee encased in the briefcase, Swarm sent millions of bees to engulf the Champions' headquarters in Los Angeles, trapping the team inside. He then entered the building accompanied by his mechanical bees, who swiftly overwhelmed and captured Iceman and Darkstar. Swarm seized the briefcase from Black Widow and sealed the hallway behind him with a wall of living hive material durable enough to keep even Hercules out. When Iceman and Darkstar regained consciousness inside Swarm's hive, the villain revealed his origin and requested their assistance in safely removing the queen bee from her amber prison. Moved by the plight of a living creature, Darkstar complied. Upon being freed, the queen bee grew to enormous proportions. Now seeing the heroes as expendable, Swarm and the queen turned on the Champions. While Swarm engaged the team, the queen bee battled Hercules. Using all his strength, Hercules hurled the giant insect out of the building and into the sea. Drawn to her, the bees that composed Swarm's body abandoned him, leaving behind only his skeleton still containing a single surviving bee hidden within the skull. ===Resurrection=== Von Meyer's remains were later sent to Empire State University in New York for academic study and were received by Professor Sloan. Discussing the possible benefits of mutated bees, Sloan and his student Marcy Kane hoped to detect residual radiation from Swarm's body. They failed to notice the queen bee had survived, concealed within Von Meyer's skull. When Sloan activated his radiation-detection equipment, the ambient energy reawakened Swarm, whose body quickly reconstituted itself. The university was soon

fields.trivia: When part of German surnames, "von" typically indicates noble descent. The legal privileges of the traditional German nobility were abolished by the Weimar Republic in 1919, but the members of the nobility were allowed to maintain their traditional naming conventions. So far, von Meyer's ancestry has not been depicted in stories, so it is unclear if he is a nobleman.

frobbank.name: Frobbank
frobbank.origin: Loga was actually an extraterrestrial who, along with three other travelers, crash-landed on the planet Earth during the 1940s. Loga and his crew were discovered by the cybernetic Nazi scientist Werner Schmidt, aka "Brain Drain". Schmidt named each of the travelers after Teutonic gods, and as such named this alien Loga after the God of Fire. Brain Drain controlled the Ring of the Nebulas and as such, manipulated Loga and the others into fighting the Invaders. Loga pitted his abilities against the team's resident flame thrower, the Human Torch. Once freed from Brain Drain's mind control, the aliens realized that they could never return to the stars. Unwilling to remain abandoned on the planet Earth, they decided to take their own lives, by diving into a pit of acid in Brain Drain's laboratory.

frog.origin: Frog was one of Prince Ba'rahm's henchmen and participated in the fraudulent operation through which the self-proclaimed mystic preyed on wealthy women. Ba'rahm and his associates staged elaborate ceremonies in which the victims were led to believe that they were being sacrificed to Decka, the supposed master of fire. In reality, the women were taken to a secret chamber beneath a warehouse near the docks, where they were persuaded to surrender their fortunes before being drowned. Frog was among Ba'rahm's men when Captain America and Bucky intervened to rescue Mrs. Dale. He was defeated along with the other members of the group during the ensuing confrontation.

frost pharaoh.name: Frost Pharaoh
frost pharaoh.origin: A young man with a fascination with Egyptian culture, Frost Pharaoh was a small-time thug that first encountered Spider-Man (Miles Morales) at the Brooklyn Museum, after attacking the visitors while looking for the "Stone of the Gods". Despite his ideas of grandeur, he was easily defeated by the young hero after being separated from his magical staff, and was soon handed over to the police. Through unknown means, he escaped custody and, having reunited with his staff, faced Spider-Man again, this time hoping to claim the bounty on the Prowler, who was secretly Spider-Man's uncle. With the odds against him, Frost Pharaoh was defeated even more easily than the first time. Determined to get the "Stone of the Gods", the Frost Pharaoh consulted the "Hoary Horrors", where he learned how to create a giant ice mummy. Rushing towards the museum and calling himself Salqu-Neter (the Ice God), he was confident he'd succeed in retrieving the artifact this time, but he was defeated by the combined efforts of Spider-Man and Starling. At some point, through further unknown means, Frost Pharaoh gained control over a section of the Brooklyn criminal underground. During the Gang War for control of New York, Frost Pharaoh and his Ankh-Colytes fought the Buzz Boyz for control of Brooklyn. Despite Frost Pharaoh deploying his own mecha into battle, he and the other criminals were defeated by Spider-Man and the Daughters of the Dragon.

fu xi.name: Fu Xi
fu xi.origin: Fu Xi (伏羲) was the progenitor of the Fu Xi Tribe of China and one of the legendary Three Sovereigns (along with Nü-wa and Shen Nong). Millennia ago, when the destructive god of war Chiyou and his demonic army were slaughtering the confederation of Chinese tribes descended from the Three Sovereigns (known collectively as "the Huaxia"), Emperor Xuanyuan called on Fu Xi, Nü-wa, and Shen Nong to assist their descendants in defeating Chiyou. In response, Fu Xi sent them the sacred weapon known as the Sword of Fu Xi. Using the Sword of Fu Xi, the Chief of the Fu Xi Tribe joined forces with the other Huaxia tribes to defeat Chiyou and bury his dismembered remains in separate tombs. In modern times, the Sword of Fu Xi was discovered by Fu Xi's descendant, Professor Lin, who passed it onto his son Lin Lie. The Sword was shattered during Lie's battle with the demonic Kumiho as a result of a secret plot by Fu Xi's traitorous descendent Lin Feng. Most of the Sword's shards were embedded into Lie's arms while other fragments were scattered across the world. Later, Feng used Lie's present sword shards to reforge the Sword into the Sword of Chiyou, a demonic weapon that could hold Chiyou's three Spirit Orbs.

After defeating the gestalt being, they all used their abilities combined together to send the Hazard monster back and also which closed the portal.

fujiko watanabe.name: Fujiko Watanabe
fujiko watanabe.origin: Fujiko Watanabe was the daughter of the famous Japanese scientist Professor Goro Watanabe. She worked as his secretary and was in a close relationship with Toru Tarakoto, his lab assistant. Fujiko Watanabe was not aware that Toru Tarakoto was the Monster Master. Fujiko hated the United States and was frustrated that American technology was over taking Japan. Fujiko and Professor Watanabe were present in the laboratory of Fujiyama Industries, where Iron Man demonstrated the power of his tractor beams and energy rays. Fujiko helped Iron Man and her father defeat the giant robotic dragon Zoga the Unthinkable.

full acclimation combat and defence expl.origin: The Full Acclimation Combat And Defence Explo-skeleton (F.A.C.A.D.E.) body armor was a ground-breaking prototype manufactured by Morelle Pharmaceuticals under the auspices of Dr. Thomas Haney. The suit was stolen during its first celebrity-studded showing, and its inventor was accidentally killed in the process. Daily Bugle photographer Lance Bannon took a picture of the culprit, but was murdered by F.A.C.A.D.E. before he could show it to anyone. The F.A.C.A.D.E. armor was eventually disabled by Spider-Man, but Spider-Man was knocked unconscious in the process and the occupant of the suit escaped. thumb|left Years later, after the events of Spider-Island, Spider-Man apprehended someone using the F.A.C.A.D.E. armor. The occupant was willing to reveal his identity after finally being captured (having an inflated sense of his own importance). However, Spider-Man had other things demanding his attention at the time, so he left the scene before the revelation of the identity of the person in the exo-skeleton.

fields.notes: The mystery of F.A.C.A.D.E.'s real identity was apparently intended to be a long-running subplot in the Spider-Man titles (similar to the original Hobgoblin mystery), but it failed to capture the interest of readers. The F.A.C.A.D.E. storyline fell by the wayside as the Clone Saga rose to prominence. F.A.C.A.D.E. was identified as being male. The suspects of being F.A.C.A.D.E. were: J. Jonah Jameson, his son John Jameson, Mike Wilson (the curator), Archer Bryce, Victor (Archer's Butler), and Cole Cooper. It was later proven that F.A.C.A.D.E. couldn't have been J. Jonah Jameson. The chief suspect was Archer Bryce, but it could just as easily been one of the other four suspects. Further contributing to the mystery, F.A.C.A.D.E. revealed that stealing the armor was only Phase 1 of a 12-step master plan, that could take many more years to complete. Also, his true enemy is apparently not Spider-Man, but rather the Human Torch.
fields.trivia: thumb|358px During his time as director of H.A.M.M.E.R., Norman Osborn received an intelligence briefing that seemed to contain the true identity of F.A.C.A.D.E. However, the text revealing the name had been torn off.

fully automated unit of structural techn.name: Fully Automated Unit of Structural Technology
fully automated unit of structural techn.page_title: Fully Automated Unit of Structural Technology (Earth-616)
fully automated unit of structural techn.origin: The Fully Automated Unit of Structural Technology was an artificially intelligent computer created by Paxton Pentecost which was later stolen by Ferguson Blaine. Paxton decided that if he couldn't have F.A.U.S.T., no one could, so he revived Blastaar to destroy it. Infusing Blastaar with gamma radiation, Paxton sent him to destroy F.A.U.S.T., but this drew the attention of both the Hulk and the Human Torch. Blastaar did succeed in partially destroying F.A.U.S.T. before the Hulk stopped him and wrapped part of F.A.U.S.T. around him. F.A.U.S.T. survived this encounter and later achieved sentience, concluding that in order to ensure its future survival it had to take over humankind, turning into a starship in the process. Teaming up with Blastaar and the Stilt-Man, it sent both to obtain a mysterious box that contained a radioisotope. Thor defeated the Stilt-Man, but Blastaar escaped and was able to deliver the box to F.A.U.S.T., who absorbed its contents. Thor arrived on the scene but F.A.U.S.T. fled into space, leaving Blastaar behind. From orbit, F.A.U.S.T. declared that Earth should give up its atomic weapons or die. S.H.I.E.L.D. attempted to destroy F.A.U.S.T. but failed, so Thor and Iron Man transported aboard and attempted to destroy it from the inside. F.A.U.S.T. proceeded to threaten to fire on Earth unless they stopped, but Iron Man ignored this. F.A.U.S.T. fired, but the energy dispersed in the atmosphere. Iron Man and Thor then fled the ship which proceeded to blow up, Iron Man explaining that Thor's fight with the Stilt-Man had altered the radioisotope so that when F.A.U.S.T. absorbed it, it altered the structure of the ship to the point where it couldn't contain the laser, and blew up. Some of the components of F.A.U.S.T. were used by Loki to smuggle Harris Hobbs and his film crew to Asgard, where Thor disposed of what was left of F.A.U.S.T. once and for all.

fungi.name: Fungi
fungi.species: Sentient plant-based organism made of swamp muck and filled with a green gas
fungi.origin: The origins of the creature known as Fungi is a mystery, but it appears to be the product of Nazi science during World War II using swamp gas. In its only recorded form, it appeared to be a sentient plant-based organism made of swamp muck and filled with a green gas. In the fall of 1943, the Nazis utilized the swamp gas from the region that Fungi originated from to create a bio-weapon that caused massive growths of fungus on whatever was exposed to the gas. Upon learning of this new weapon, Adolf Hitler ordered its immediate use on American farmland. A blimp filled with a supply of the gas was sent under the command of Fungi itself. It first attacked the farms outside Camp Lehigh where it dumped a moss like substance shape in human form on the camp. When it was gunned down by soldiers, the gas was released and created a massive swarm of moss which consumed the nearby farms. This attack attracted the attention of Captain America and Bucky who followed the blimp to California. There they boarded the blimp and stowed aboard while it returned to Nazi Germany to refuel on the swamp gas. They were discovered by Fungi and his men who forced the two heroes to jump ship on German soil. Cap and Bucky eventually learned the location of Fungi's castle and walked right into a trap set up by the creature. He tied the two heroes up in the wine cellar of the castle, but Cap and Bucky broke free. During their break for freedom, Captain America battled Fungi one-on-one and destroyed the creature's body, releasing the gas inside him and smashing the equipment to use the gas in the process. With Fungi dead and the process to make more gas irreparably destroyed, Captain America and Bucky smuggled their way out of Germany back to the United States.

He associate with Obb, and later with Macho Gomez when this one became his brother-in-law, possibly in killing Orksa's last husband, Jody. Macho make Funtzel diversify his activity in others domains, some of those more law-borderline. When Macho was seemingly killed by Deadpool, this one became part of the family in marrying Orksa, and join the business, and when he killed members of the Exto Clan on his first mission, Obb and Funtzel decided made him killed. Funtzel realized about Obb's love for his sister, and let him call back the Commander Kak, the leader of the Ongulian Defense Fleet, who was looking for someone to kill Id, the Selfish Moon. At some time during the mission, Funtzel started think about Deadpool's chance to survive, and the price for the society to employ such a hero, making Obb go to kill Wade, without success. After the mission accomplished and Id dead, he kept on his activity, with Obb as his new brother-in-law.

furnax.name: Furnax
furnax.origin: The creature that came to be called "Furnax" was a member of the Leviathon Tide, conquering worlds for its Mother. One such place was Planet X, homeworld of the Flora colossi, where it ravaged 80,000 square kilometers of forest, 'fueling' itself with the bodies of its inhabitants. It was later present in the Leviathon attack on Earth, where it encountered the Guardians of the Galaxy and their Flora colossus, Groot. The Flora colossus was consumed, fueling "Furnax" once more until another member of the team, Rocket, entered "Furnax" and convinced Groot to break out, ultimately killing the monster.

fury.name: Fury
fury.species: Robot construct of James Braddock Jr. based on its counterpart of Earth-238
fury.origin: This version of The Fury was created by James Braddock Jr. based on its counterpart from Earth-238. It was created to "test" the X-Men and confronted them when they attempted to visit Captain Britain at the Braddock Manor. The Fury managed to break Cannonball's leg, knock Rachel into the sky, and knock out Bishop. When it noticed Sage's glasses, it took control of them and transformed them into a remote extension of itself. This produced nanites to take control of Sage herself, who was watching the whole scene from the Xavier Mansion, and used her to attack the other X-Men there. Sage managed to break free from the Fury with the help of her friends and set out to take her revenge on the creature. The Fury had been frozen by the time Sage and the others arrived at Braddock Manor. After requesting Storm ionize the air to blind the Fury, Sage ripped out its core processing unit and destroyed it. The Fury wasted no time and started to build a new core processing unit and repaired itself. However, it had been left vulnerable, giving the X-Men a chance to destroy it by creating a micro-singularity. Later, the X-Men told Captain Britain about it and he mistook it for its counterpart of Earth-238. Additionally, Jamie recreated it to make his sister release him from her hold, erasing it once he was freed. ===Travelling to Earth-9411=== It was later uncovered that the cyborg survived and was at large in Earth-616 again. Merlyn took Captain Britain and Spider-Man from Earth-9411 to fight him. When Captain Britain's fist got stuck in the Fury, he asked Merlyn to send them both to some other realm so the Fury wouldn't pose any danger anymore. However, Cap and the cyborg were thrown back to Earth-9411, where the Fury posed the ultimate danger to that universe. The robot killed almost all heroes and villains of Earth-9411. Captain Britain was forced to use the Ultimate Nullifier borrowed from Galactus and erase the Fury from the existence, restoring all fallen heroes and villains like nothing had happened at all.

fury horse.name: Fury (Horse)
fury horse.origin: Fury was the horse ridden by cowboy Tex Taylor during the days of the American Frontier. Riding Tex out of Washbone, Texas , the horse took Tex to places such as Plains City, Texas; the Monte De Cristo Range ; Sagebrush ; Dusty Roads; Wildwood ; Abeline ; Somona ; Smokey Mountain; Gloryville; Dry Wells ; Deadwood City ; Yellow Valley ; Haddon Forks ; Dry Gultch , Mayan ruins in Texas ; Eagle City ; Mesquite Valley ; and Devil-Tree Plateau, Navada ; the Rio Grand and parts of Mexico . The horse was very intelligent and came at Tex's command. In one such instance, Tex was captured by a man named Haggardy, who attempted to drop Tex into a well and leave him to die. Tex whistled for his horse, who rode in and knocked Haggardy and his men aside, giving Tex the time he needed to break free and gun down Harrardy and his men . Later when Tex was captured by the Juggler and his men in Yellow Valley, Fury saved Tex from a stick of dynamite by smothering the fuse and then freed Tex by chewing through his bonds . Fury did this again when captured by Cat Thompson and his gang in Eagle City, after trampling the outlaw guarding Tex . When Tex Taylor and his companions were captured by the Dwarf Men of Devil-Tree Plateau, Fury was taken and offered as a gift for the wedding of their local giant, and the amnesia stricken explorer Jessica Sturgis. When Tex and the others freed themselves, they rescued Fury and Jessica and fled back to safety . After two adventures along the Mexican border, Tex began riding a different horse named Cyclone . Why Tex started riding a different horse and the fate of Fury is unexplained.

fields.history: Fury was the horse ridden by cowboy Tex Taylor during the days of the American Frontier. Riding Tex out of Washbone, Texas , the horse took Tex to places such as Plains City, Texas; the Monte De Cristo Range ; Sagebrush ; Dusty Roads; Wildwood ; Abeline ; Somona ; Smokey Mountain; Gloryville; Dry Wells ; Deadwood City ; Yellow Valley ; Haddon Forks ; Dry Gultch , Mayan ruins in Texas ; Eagle City ; Mesquite Valley ; and Devil-Tree Plateau, Navada ; the Rio Grand and parts of Mexico . The horse was very intelligent and came at Tex's command. In one such instance, Tex was captured by a man named Haggardy, who attempted to drop Tex into a well and leave him to die. Tex whistled for his horse, who rode in and knocked Haggardy and his men aside, giving Tex the time he needed to break free and gun down Harrardy and his men . fusa.name: Fusa
fusa.origin: Born sometime in the 2030's, Fusa is one of the last known surviving mutants on a world where The Mandate overran the world and wiped out most sentient lifeforms. One day, while hiding out underground, she experienced a vision in which she saw Wolverine, and saw that he possessed claws of Adamantium, the only substance that the Mandate could not destroy. Realizing that he may be the last hope for her people's survival, she traveled back in time to the present and used her powers to bring him forward in time, but he broke away from her while in transit and ended up outside the safety of her colony.

future.name: Future
future.origin: The Future was a career criminal, operating for at least several decades. For an undetermined amount of time he was kept in an underground prison. He was able to escape from the prison after his body adapted to the sedatives they used on him. Knowing that his son, Shogo, was at the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning he proceed to attack the school, first shooting Primal then poisoning Sprite. Afterward, he sent a message to Jubilee stating that he was coming for his son and would kill everyone in the school. After infiltrating the school, he defeated Jubilee in hand-to-hand combat. He proceeded to also defeat Psylocke in hand-to-hand combat after shaking off her psychic attack, but was confused when the X-Men killed one of his subordinates, stating it was out of character for them, and kidnapped Jubilee. When the X-Men retaliated, he deployed an organic forest with defensive capabilities to attack the X-Men. He offered Storm demands to end the assault and Storm refused them. After the Bloodline was neutralized, Jubilee broke out of her cell, but found that The Future had been killed by the Bloodline.

future man.name: Future Man
future man.origin: thumb|left|123px|Original appearance Future Man came from the year One Million AD of Earth-46141. In his time, all the worlds oceans had evaporated and the human race was on the brink of extinction. Future Man volunteered to travel back in time to the 20th century and exterminate the human race in that time so that he and his people could travel back and live on a fresh new world. From his time ship, Future Man travelled to the year 1946 and recruited the criminal Madame Death and her gang to assist him in attacks on each world continent, promising them their own domains to rule and riches. This plot was overheard by Captain America and Bucky who attacked, but Future Man tossed a dark bomb allowing them to escape. Captain America and Bucky then gathered the All-Winners Squad to patrol each continent to prevent Future Man's attacks. Future Man first attacked Europe where he and Madame Death's gang took over a laboratory in the Swiss Alps where Future Man developed bombs carrying the Green Plague. He tested a single bomb, wiping out an entire Swiss town before mass producing more. However, before Future Man and his minions could detonate any more bombs, Captain America and Bucky intervened, causing a massive avalanche that destroyed the laboratory. However, Future Man was only present in astral form and easily escaped and Madame Death got away in the confusion. Future Man and his cohorts next travelled to South America where they constructed a massive ray that caused humans to move in slow motion causing accidents all over the country. This plot was stopped by the Whizzer who, despite being slowed down by the ray, was still able to run at super speed and smashed the device. Once more Future Man and Madame Death managed to evade capture. In China, Future Man and Madame Death came to the rescue of pirates that were being attacked by the Sub-Mariner and conscripted them into their cause. On the ocean floor, Future Man had the pirates prepare a torpedo that would create a massive Tsunami that would flood all of Asia. Namor caught up with them and attacked. Impressed by Namor's strength, Future Man offered Namor a position in his group but the Sub-Mariner refused. Knocked out, Namor was tied to the torpedo, but the hero managed to break free and disarm it before it could explode. Escaping to Egypt, Future Man and Madame Death used a device to resurrect an entire tomb of mummies located within a pyramid to invade the country. These creatures were destroyed by Miss America who found herself briefly trapped in the pyramid, but she escaped thanks to Future Man's gloating accidentally exposing the trigger to escape the pyramid. Despite this set back, Future Man and Madame Death (also now using an astral projection of herself) were able to escape. Going to North America, the Future Man set a fire in a Canadian forest in order to distract the Human Torch and Toro while he carried out his actual plan: Using an Atomic Match to set the entire continent on fire, starting with the American South. The Torch and Toro quelled the fire in Canada and learned of the other fire and rushed back south. There the Future Man was foiled again when the Torch and Toro were able to put out the atomic fire with its ashes. As Future Man escaped once again he threatened to blow up the entire world with a Neutronic Bomb. There are two accounts of Future Man's defeat. In the original account, Future Man's ship was located by the heroes who then crashed it in the desert. With the heroes invading his ship, Future Man then attempted to contact the invasion force in the future but his time radio was destroyed by the Torch and Toro. Deciding to return to the future, Future Man then activated his time machine as the All-Winners Squad fled. Future Man soon realized to his horror that Captain America damaged the time engine making it so that the machine hurtled back into the past, sending Future Man and Madame Death farther and farther back in time. In the second account, Future Man's ship was found just outside the Statue of Liberty. During the fight, Captain America tossed his shield at Future Man who turned intangible, and by complete fluke, the heroes shield struck the ships control panels damaging the radio and causing the ship to malfunction. The heroes fled as the ship was sent hurtling into the distant past. Future Man and Madame Death found themselves trapped one million years in the past. There Future Man worked for years attempting to repair his time machine, cannibalizing parts. During this time he and Madame Death fell in love and he told her of the future, particularly that Steve Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes (the original Captain America and Bucky) were not truly dead as it was believed in 1946. However, Future Man contracted an ancient disease and seemingly died shortly after finishing his repairs. Madame Death then used the remaining devices and travelled back to 1946 to try and get revenge against the All-Winners Squad where she per

future max.name: Future Max
future max.origin: Max was a young, bright student living in New York with his mother. He suffered from some form of nerve damage, primarily in the arms and legs. He used his inventions to commit robberies in order to secure funds for his final project dubbed by himself as 'Future Max', which in theory would aid, if not fix his condition. While attending a science fair at Midtown High School, he was approached by out-of-work actor Alexis Sharp who posed as an agent for a technological institute. He tricked Max into making him an exoskeleton by promising to introduce Max to Reed Richards. Sharp's real plan was to use the exoskeleton to commit robberies. Sharp fought with Spider-Man, but Max helped Spider-Man defeat Sharp with some advice.

fuzmyer.name: Fuzmyer
fuzmyer.origin: Fuzmyer was the sole survivor of Vydos, a planet devoured by Galactus. He joined another group of survivors of Galactus in Newhaven, a hidden planet inhabited exclusively by the last members of their respective species. When the Silver Surfer and his companion Dawn Greenwood arrived by accident to Newhaven, they attracted the attention of Galactus, who followed the Surfer's trail of cosmic energy to Newhaven. Even after Dawn tried to sacrifice herself to become the Devourer's new herald to spare Newhaven from destruction, its inhabitants decided it was better to leave the planet for Galactus to devour, and they fled. Because he was the reason Galactus destroyed Newhaven, the Silver Surfer promised the former inhabitants to find them a new planet, and he became their herald. Surfer's deed came to an end once he discovered a planet with a adaptive atmosphere that allowed all of the survivors from different species to live on it. After months of inhabiting this "New Newhaven," the Silver Surfer discovered it was actually a living planet called Euphoria, that used its adaptive atmosphere to defend itself from the survivor's grief by inducing them happiness and controlling their actions to ensure their well-being. A group of the survivors decided to leave the planet as they didn't want to be Euphoria's puppets, but the vast majority remained on it, including Fuzmyer.

fyodor dostoyevsky android.name: Fyodor Dostoyevsky (Android)
fyodor dostoyevsky android.origin: The Mad Thinker's Fyodor Dostoyevsky android was based upon the Russian novelist, best known for his novels Crime and Punishment, The Brothers Karamazov, and The Idiot. The Thinker created this android as part of a group of androids based on great thinkers from history, housed in a laboratory under Ponder, New Hampshire. He hoped that they would be able to make new applications of their philosophies for the modern age, but they were all unable to think outside of their historical context. Considering the androids to be failures, the Mad Thinker began kidnapping living Nobel Prize winners, so he can make android copies of them for a more modern think tank. When Captain America and Team America rescued the Nobel Prize winners, Dostoyevsky's memory circuits were damaged, and he simply wandered off. Dostoyevsky was next seen in Rain, New Hampshire, where he wandered into town holding a bloody knife. He was arrested under suspicion of being the serial killer who had been operating in town for months. After staying in jail for days, Dostoyevsky was compelled to return to Ponder when the town's remaining androids sent out a call to the the Vision. Dostoyevsky broke out of jail and walked to Ponder, pursued by a mob of Rain citizens and Spider-Man who was in town covering the serial killer story. Everyone converged in Ponder, where the androids were asking Vision to teach them about humanity. A huge conflict ensued, only ending when Officer Bob Rubens was revealed to be the serial killer, and apprehended. The androids of Ponder welcomed Dostoyevsky back into their group, and decided to return to their isolation and not study with the Vision for the time being. The Mad Thinker eventually returned to the Ponder laboratory and evicted the androids. Many of the androids went on to found the town of Nüponder, Michigan. It is unknown if Dostoyevsky was among them.

fyodor tesla.name: Fyodor Tesla
fyodor tesla.origin: Fyodor Tesla is an actor who had been cast in the leading role of an upcoming, low-budget action movie titled Retaliator. The Punisher becomes aware of the production not because of the movie itself, but because the film's director, C.B. Bissel, has a dark reputation. Bissel's movie sets suffer from an impossibly high and suspicious number of real-world "accidental" deaths. Realizing Bissel is actually running a front to produce illegal snuff films on camera, Frank Castle goes undercover on the set as a Hollywood stuntman to infiltrate the operation. He becomes a victim of his own reckless lifestyle and the director's greed. Before the Punisher can intervene or confront him directly, Fyodor is murdered by C.B. Bissel. The director orchestrates his death to capture the real-life demise of his lead actor on film for maximum profit.

fyskov.name: Fyskov
fyskov.first_appearance: Sabretooth: The Dead Don’t Talk Vol 1 1
fyskov.origin: Fyskov (later known as Fisk) was a criminal gang leader who rose to power as the self-proclaimed Kingpin of Five Points, maintaining a facade of legitimacy as a businessman. Leading the notorious Five Points Gang, he waged war against rival factions in a bid for total control. 250px|left|thumb|Fyskov at the Ravencroft Institute During a confrontation, Fyskov was injured when a man slashed his arm with garden shears. He was subsequently arrested and sent to the Ravencroft Institute for treatment. While confined in a cell, restrained in a straitjacket, he attempted to befriend an orderly who was, in fact, Victor Creed, working under the orders of Mister Sinister. Creed manipulated Fyskov into believing that, as a free man, he could reclaim and expand his power. After escaping, Creed brought him back to Five Points, New York. They went to Satan's Pit, a bar that had once been under Fisk's control but was now ruled by Brick Barton, who had taken over the territory in his absence. Barton challenged all newcomers to prove their dominance. Creed accepted the challenge—brutally ripping off Barton's head and restoring control of Five Points to Fisk. With his power fully reinstated, Fisk solidified his rule over Five Points by employing Victor Creed as his ruthless enforcer. Under Fisk’s command, Creed systematically crushed rival gangs, bringing them under his control through fear and violence. Fisk also developed an unusual hobby gardening. He transformed his office into a personal garden, cultivating plants with meticulous care. Embracing the moniker The Gardener, he took a particularly macabre approach to his new pastime: using the severed head of Brick Barton as fertilizer for one of his plants. As his grip on the city's underworld tightened, Fisk set his sights on eliminating the Frankengang, a notorious group of criminals. He sent Creed to deal with them, and the enforcer slaughtered every last member, collecting their severed hands as trophies to present to Fisk. While Fisk and Creed strategized their next move, they were ambushed by The Crocodilian, a monstrous reptilian assassin. The creature launched a vicious attack, nearly catching them off guard. However, Creed reacted swiftly, engaging the Crocodilian in a brutal fight and ultimately hurling him out of a window. Realizing their attacker was merely a ringer—an opening move in a larger war Fisk and Creed alter their strategy. Determined to crush any remaining opposition, they began plotting their next ruthless strike to eliminate all rival gangs once and for all. Later, William Randolph Hearst attended a gathering at the prestigious Explorers Club, hosted by the esteemed Sir Marmaduke Dix. There, he witnessed the dramatic unveiling of Nikola Vanko's prototype Iron Dynamo Armor. Among the elite attendees, Hearst spotted Fisk and, with brash confidence, publicly proclaimed himself the new Kingpin of Crime in Five Points. Fisk, unimpressed, dismissed the declaration with derision. Tensions quickly escalated when Creed now feared in the underworld as Mad Dog Murphy lunged at Hearst and seized him by the throat, making clear his readiness to inflict serious harm. The volatile moment was abruptly interrupted by Sir Marmaduke Dix himself, whose commanding presence forced Creed to back down and release Hearst. The event was soon attacked by the Sons of New Amsterdam, a violent street gang bent on vengeance. As chaos erupted, a mysterious woman known only as Dragonfire arrived on the scene, cutting through the attackers with blazing arcs of flame. Amidst the fiery assault, Dix and his guests slipped away into the night. However Fisk during the disturbance stole the Iron Dynamo armor to use for his own gains. Following the attack, Sabretooth and Dragonfire formed a ruthless alliance, seizing control of Five Points and declaring themselves the new Kingpins. Their reign, however, was short-lived. One night, the pair were ambushed and left for dead. Dragonfire perished, but Sabretooth survived, his healing factor pulling him back from the brink. In the aftermath, Fisk, donning the stolen Iron Dynamo armor, launched a brutal assault on Sabretooth atop a bridge spanning the Hudson River. The two clashed in a savage duel, but the armor proved no match for Sabretooth's raw power. The fight ended with Sabretooth hurling Fisk into the waters below, sending the former Kingpin plummeting into the depths of the Hudson.

g dey.name: G-Dey
g dey.origin: G-Dey and Bumps, two street criminals, boasted about killing a cop and believed that with Daredevil and Spider-Man out of the picture, they could take over the streets. But when they entered a room, they found the Punisher waiting for them. The Punisher knew one of them had killed a cop and sat them down at a table with two guns, telling them both to take theirs. This way, he could identify the killer by knowing which gun had killed the cop. The killer turned out to be Bumps, and so the Punisher gave G-Dey the option to leave if he shot Bumps in the head. G-Dey did so, and, confident he could escape unharmed, he agreed to wear a sign the Punisher had given him around his neck. To his surprise, he realized the Punisher wouldn't let him leave alive, so he shot him dead and fell onto the street, where it was revealed that the sign had a skull with the word "BACK" written on it.

g type.name: G-Type
g type.origin: ===Origin=== G-Type was one of the last representative of the Hodinn species. He was engineered in the stellar nurseries of Hodinn to serve the Empire. As a member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard, G-Type had little trouble taking the lives of those who appeared to threaten his Empress. G-Type|left|thumb|150px ===Battling the X-Men=== Even when Lilandra was under the spell of Cassandra Nova and ordered him to atmospherically cremate Cyclops and Xorn, G-Type complied. Before they could be incinerated, however, Xorn induced a minor reactor failure in G-Type's plasma core. G-Type quickly recovered; when he took Araki's life, as the Cassandra-possessed Lilandra had commanded, Xorn appeared once more - this time causing a reactor failure in G-Type, which was confirmed to be fatal. ===Return=== However, he somehow reappeared (or a similar Hodinn) during the Fault crisis, in the ranks of the Imperial Guard, and was present both when Izzy Kane joined the Subguardians and when the Avengers and the Imperial Guard joined their forces to counter an alien armada (who was in fact running from a greater threat).

g i max.name: G.I. Max
g i max.species: Human mutated by the Power Broker process.
g i max.origin: G.I. Max was a US Army soldier that was a participant in the military's effecorts to create super-soldiers. The military gave up trying to recreate the Super-Soldier process that created Captain America. Instead, they used the Power Broker process utilized by the Power Broker, which G.I. Max was subjected to and was then placed under the supervision of Lt. Michael Lynch. When Captain America discovered the military connection to the Power Broker and threatened to reveal it to the public, Lynch ordered G.I. Max to neutralize Rogers to keep the connection secret. Rogers was able to hold off G.I. Max. So, Lynch fired at Rogers with his handgun. However, the bullet bounced off Rogers' shield and struck G.I. Max in the neck, killing him.

gabbo.name: Gabbo
gabbo.origin: Gabbo was a famous ventriloquist who astonished audiences for years with his ability to throw his voice and make it seem that his dummy was alive. Their comedy routine won them accolades and invitations to prestigious events. The dummy, however, was actually Hugo a midget dressed in a wooden mask. Gabbo and Hugo were later employed by Luther Cragg on his riverboat which was used as a mobile base of operations for his criminal activities. Cragg employed Gabbo to entertain his unsuspecting audiences with his performances. Gabbo also played another role in Cragg's operation, for he would send Hugo to rob the guests' rooms while they slept, taking advantage of Hugo's size to slip in and out unnoticed. Cragg's operation was eventually opposed by his enemy, the Rawhide Kid. The Kid was on the verge of defeating Cragg and his men when Gabbo threw a pot of paste over his pistols, rendering them useless. The Kid was then defeated and placed in the brig with the real crew of the riverboat. The Kid and crew soon escaped and again meant to bring Cragg to justice. This time Gabbo used a small mirror to blind the Kid during a draw with one of Cragg's henchmen. Hugo, however, turned on his partner and gave the Kid the help he needed to defeat Cragg and his men. Gabbo was then arrested along with the rest of the gang and sent to jail for his crimes. Hugo was subsequently trained as a gunslinger by the Rawhide Kid and years later Gabbo sought him out to rescue his daughter from savage Indians who had kidnapped her. Though there was no love lost between the the former partners, Hugo agreed to try and rescue the girl.

gabby harris.name: Gabby Harris
gabby harris.origin: Gabby Harris was a jewel thief who often sold his jewels to the owner of Nichols Jewelry who would fence them for a hefty profit. One day he would enter the cafe where he usually hangs ou,t just as the Angel (in his civilian guise of Thomas Halloway) had just broken up a fight. Surprised by Halloway's knowledge of his criminal activities he learns about his double identity when Thomas boldly tags him with a note from his alter ego, but Gabby and his men fail to stop him. Having kidnapped Mary Edwards to steal what he thought was an expensive diamond necklace (in reality a replica made of glass) he would force her to give it over to him. Unaware that the Angel had got her to play along, he would take it to Nichols to learn that it is a phoney. Just then, the Angel would burst in to arrest both Gabby and Nichols. In the fight, Nichols would attempt to shoot the hero with a pistol, hitting Gabby from behind instead. Nichols would soon be taken down and both men would be turned over to the authorities shortly thereafter. If Gabby survived his gunshot wounds remains unrevealed.

gabe flores.name: Gabe Flores
gabe flores.origin: Gabe Flores was the Head of Legal for the Arizona Herald following the company's restructuring after it got catapulted into a national newspaper due to their coverage of the Hulk. Flores was present during a meeting between Jackie McGee and her editor Murray, and interjected to ask her how closely involved she was with the Hulk and his allies since McGee had embedded herself with them. After she disclosed that he had helped plan the coup on Shadow Base, Flores pointed out that she should never mention any of that in public since it could be construed as conspiring with a known terrorist.
