general kreigkopf.name: General Kreigkopf
general kreigkopf.origin: General Kreigkopf was a very dangerous man whose military service predated the Siancong War. He was stated to be aggressive, ruthless, tactically brilliant, and tapped for the very, very top. During his military service, he rewarded his men by allowing them to rape and pillage, deployed an untested nerve agent in an urban area, and used half a company of Iraqi prisoners for bayonet practice. None of these acts could be proved, and as he knew where the bodies were buried, he went unpunished. Then he crippled a nineteen year old lance corporal in front of a C.N.N. camera crew, after which he left the country, presumably with the C.I.A's help, for whom he had done some work. He then set himself up on Grand Nixon Island and became its leader, recruiting former soldiers, killers, and psychopaths to work for him and keeping the island safe from any military strike due to no one wanting the secrets he kept to get out. The General came into possession of the remains of the Russian, whom he had rebuilt and resurrected using stolen S.H.I.E.L.D. tech and got him to agree to join up after allowing him to go up against the Punisher who had previously killed him. Kreigkopf got the okay from President Bush to have the Russian operate in New York City. This didn't go quite how he had hoped and Castle made his way to G.N.I. and began to slaughter the inhabitants as he hunted down the General for sending the Russian after him. The General had believed his men or the Russian would be able to kill Castle, but Castle won out against them and stopped the General from dropping a stolen French nuclear bomb on Brussels to destabilize Europe, to insure no one made a move against him and to attract new business opportunities. Castle shot the General and then dropped the bomb on G.N.I., vaporizing all the inhabitants including the General.

Some time later, when Iron Man was hit by a Firepower's missile in Casa Grande, he ordered all the soldier to get to the shelters .; After some follow-up tests on the Firepower armor, Meade and Senator Boynton wanted to take custody of the armor, but Cord refused to give it to them and had Taggert blow up the flatbed truck they were going to use to take away the armor .

general nikki.name: General Nikki
general nikki.origin: General Nikki was a member of the Imperial Japanese army who was active during World War II. In 1943, he had sent a number of his agents to steal a shrink ray device that was invented by Professor Livingston. The night of the attack, the spies were opposed by Private Steve Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes who were close friends of Livingston and secretly Captain America and Bucky. They failed to stop the spies from stealing the device and murdering Livingston. Six months later, the General had mastered control of the shrink ray and used it to shrink an entire Japanese invasion force down to size and carry it in a cylinder that was dubbed the "Cylinder of Death" and sought to smuggle it into the United States and launch a full out assault on American soil starting in California. This information was learned by a Russian spy named Olga who doubled as a nightclub dancer in the States. She put a message in the newspaper to contact Captain America, prompting Rogers and Barnes to investigate. The two heroes learned of the Cylinder of Death (but not of its actual contents) and went to Black Rock Cove to stop General Nikki and his men from landing on the beach. The two heroes were outnumbered and knocked out and taken to the spies secret hideout. There, they broke free and learned of the contents of the cylinder while Japanese agents were using it to restore the army to its original size. Captain America and Bucky fought off some of the growing tanks and jets, causing a massive fire that caused an explosion that destroyed the shrink ray. General Nikki mobilized those forces that were restored to their original size and led them to a nearby dam to destroy it. Captain America and Bucky got the assistance of a nearby Air Force base to mount a counter attack. The invaders were decimated by American forces and clashing with Captain America atop the dam, General Nikki was thrown to his death.

After the Sentinel had dealt with Domino, Nobakov reported this to Strelonovich, and when Nobakov told her that the mutant would help Dr. Kamarofski to better use the Sentinel, she replied that it was good and that it might expedite the time schedule was a good thing, but when Nobakov asked her what the time schedule was about, she apologized to him, saying that until now it had been necessary to keep him in the dark about some ambitious plans. Then the Governor showed that they had many Sentinels bought on the black market and thanks to the modifications made by Dr. Kamarofski they could use them against any enemy with the intention of invading Symkaria.

general olga.name: General Olga
general olga.origin: The woman known as General Olga was a commanding officer in the People's Liberation Army of China during the 1950s. During the Korean War she commanded soldiers in the region. During her tenure here she captured American soldiers Battle Brady and Socko Swenski. She had her men dress in the American G.I.'s uniforms and learn of troop movements near a location called Sniper's Ridge and set up catapults on either side to launch explosives into the advancing enemy troops. Her plan was foiled when Battle and Socko manages to escape their execution and while posing as Chinese soldiers, rigged the catapults to launch across the ridge to the other side of the barrage. When Olga and her minions launched the explosives at the sound of Battle's false warning signal, they ended up launching the explosives at each other. General Olga was seemingly killed in the blast along with the rest of her minions. However, Olga survived the blast by commanding her soldiers to form a human shield around her, killing them but saving her from the blast. Seeking revenge against Battle Brady and Socko Swenski, she captured them and had them lowered into a shark infested lake in an air tight bag. The pair however managed to escape again, and then disabled the breaks on Olga's convoy of trucks causing them to push her and her troops into the water to be devoured by the sharks . Olga survived this attack as well, and soon became aware of wanted posters offering a reward for whoever captures or kills Battle Brady and Socko Swenski. Unaware that this was a prank made up by Battle's comrades, Olga mobilized an army of troops to attack the two Americans. However, no matter what she threw at them, Battle and Socko managed to survive the attacks eventually forcing Olga to retreat when the two soldiers succeeded in slaying every soldier she sent at them. Later, Battle and Socko were captured once again by General Olga who imprisoned them aboard a junk ship that was part of an entire fleet that were converted into battleships that were being launched as a secret attack. However the pair started a fire aboard the ship to alert their fellow troops and the junk ships were destroyed. General Olga once more escaped capture . Olga resurfaced shortly thereafter and captured the pair again, this time she forced Battle to use his ranching skills to help her herd cattle that would feed her troops. Instead, Battle caused a stampede allowing the two Americans to escape her clutches again. thumb|left|159px|General Olga as a Russian At some point during the war General Olga clashed with Combat Kelly and Cookie Novak, in an as yet unrecorded clash. Seeking revenge she stole them from Muktong Mollie a soldier of fortune seeking to claim the bounty on their heads. However her chance for revenge was foiled by the interventions of the Panther Lady, Yalu River Rosie, Korea Katie, and Muktong Mollie other enemies of the two Americans who also sought the right to get revenge. Ultimately the five women began to fight among themselves allowing Combat and Cookie to free themselves and take them all prisoner.

general suki.name: General Suki
general suki.origin: General Suki was a member of the Imperial Japanese Navy during World War II. In the fall of 1944, he plotted an attack on the United States from a naval base located on Kobe Island. When he sent instructions to Japanese spies imprisoned in an American concentration camp, the military was tipped off and sent the Human Torch and Toro to destroy the naval base. Arriving on the base, the Torch and Toro were captured by Suki's men and brought before him. Suki had them bound to a device that sprayed them with ice cold water that threatened to stop their circulation and left them to die while he led the invasion fleet. The Torch and Toro managed to break free from the trap and attacked Suki's command ship, disabling it. They then reignited the volcano on Kobe Island causing a massive volcanic eruption that flooded the base with lava and killed Suki and his men.

general von savage.name: General von Savage
general von savage.origin: General von Savage was a member of the Nazis who was active during World War II. By the start of 1944, he was stationed along the coast of France where he was involved in a third effort by the Nazis to construct a tunnel between France and England. When Free French resistance fighters learned of increased German forces in the area, they attempted to warn Allied Forces who were preparing for an invasion of France. When the leader of the French resistance was captured, Von Savage ordered him tortured to learn of the Allied invasion plans. When Captain America and Bucky came to rescue him, Von Savage ordered their capture. When attempts to get information out of them failed, he ordered them tortured as well. However, Captain America and Bucky broke free and rescued the resistance fighter as well. Learning of the tunnel, they stole a supply truck filled with explosives and rode it to the tunnel. When Von Savage and his men arrived at the scene, they were too late to stop Captain America and Bucky from setting the explosives. The resulting explosion killed Von Savage and his men.

general yokima.name: General Yokima
general yokima.origin: General Yokima was a member of the Imperial Japanese Army during World War II. By the fall of 1944, he was in charge of moving troops off the Manchukio-Russian frontier as part of a large strike force that was going to invade the United States. When the Allied Forces began learning of his plans, Yokima ordered his men to dig a tunnel underground between Tokyo and the west coast of the United States. With the tunnel completed, he intended to ship his men travel through the tunnel in rapid speed blimps, making a stop at Marcus Island where weapons and explosives were waiting to be loaded onto the blimps before they continued on their invasion route. The plans were learned by American authorities and soon General Douglas MacArthur was visited by Captain America and Bucky who promised to learn the full scope of the invasion and stop it if possible. When the two heroes were smuggled into Tokyo, they were captured by Yokima's men and taken prisoner. When interrogations revealed that the two heroes knew nothing of the true scope of their plans, Yokima ordered them executed while he went to lead the invasion. Captain America and Bucky managed to free themselves and learned of the tunnel. However, they arrived too late to stop the flee from starting its course. Stealing a plane, the pair flew to Marcus Island where they beat back Japanese forces and used the explosives to blow up the tunnel. Yokima and his men were killed in the explosion and flooding of the tunnel.

genesis.name: Genesis
genesis.first_appearance: Free Comic Book Day 2020 (X-Men/Dark Ages) Vol 1 1
genesis.origin: ===Okkara=== thumb|left|Genesis Genesis was the wife of Apocalypse and ruled the ancient mutant land of Okkara alongside him. She bore him four children who she often beat them severely when they displayed weakness which led to them becoming the First Horsemen. When Okkara was attacked by the Amenthi Daemons, Genesis led the mutants to battle. When the mutants appeared the be winning, the dark elder god of Amenth, Annihilation, offered a peace treaty to Genesis but only if she would pass a test. Genesis seemed to easily pass the test but the terms of peace Annihilation whispered to Genesis were known only to her. Annihilation offered to just end the war immediately with no further incident, only if Genesis simply asked it and the daemons to leave. Genesis refused as she was obsessed with winning the war at all costs, believing it would strengthen her people, and so the war continued. After Genesis' sister, Isca the Unbeaten, a mutant with the power to never lose, betrayed her people by siding with the forces of Amenth, it became clear that the mutants could not win. It was decided that Arakko (one of Okkara's split halves) and all of the Okkaran mutants would be sealed off into Amenth to halt the invasion and hold off the Daemons, while Apocalypse remained on Earth to rally a new mutant society capable of repelling the demons when they inevitably returned one day. ===Arakko=== After being sealed away in Amenth, Genesis and the other mutants decided to make Arrako their home and built towers to protect them from the threat of the Daemons. She along with the Great Ring of Arakko ruled over Arakko for millennia, while fending off the Daemons' attacks. However, at some point in time the High Mutant Prophet Idyll foresaw the inevitable defeat of Arakko and warned the Council. Genesis dismissed the claim as nonsense, but decided to rally an army which she led on a years long crusade to end the threat of Amenth for good. Their battles became legends on Arakko and their victories were celebrated. Driving deeper into Amenth than ever before, they encountered the White Sword, and his One Hundred Champions. The White Sword had sacrificed himself to hold back the daemons during the initial invasion of Amenth and was long believed dead. The years of isolation had driven him mad and he saw no difference between Genesis and her armies and the daemonic hordes he repelled on a daily basis. He would deal Genesis' army its first defeat, eventually forcing them to retreat to Arakko. thumb|right|Genesis wearing the Annihilation (Earth-616)|Annihilation helm When she returned, she found her sister Isca waiting for her, carrying an invitation from Annihilation to parlay. Genesis accepted and went to the Hall of Annihilation where Annihilation and her army awaited her. There she learned that Annihilation and the Daemons had merely been biding their time, breeding its daemons with mutant captives to create a powerful hybrid warrior race. Annihilation again offered terms of peace, but Genesis refused and the two fought. The two fought fiercely, and eventually Genesis defeated the dark god, severing the Golden Helm of Annihilation from its host. She did not realize what this meant however; by removing Annihilation from its host, she left the Amenthi horde leaderless. Without the control of its master, the horde would consume everything or die trying. The full might of Amenth attacked Arakko while Genesis remained captive in the Hall of Annihilation. For a century she refused to claim the helm until the hordes cracked the walls of Arakko. Desperate, the mutants of Arakko opened a gateway to Dryador in Otherworld. Realizing that all was lost, and the daemons would soon be free to leave Amenth, she donned the helm hoping to be able to control it. She failed, and fell under the sway of Annihilation. Under the control of Annihilation, she captured Arakko and prepared to marshall her forces to invade Otherworld and ultimately Earth. ===X of Swords=== After pacifying Arakko, the Annihilation-possessed Genesis ordered an assault on Dryador. At the same time, she sent her grandson Summoner to Krakoa in order to make contact with Apocalypse and manipulate him into opening a route to Otherworld, allowing the Amenthi daemons to invade the Earth. The plan was a success, and as Dryador was destroyed and the Starlight Citadel besieged, Apocalypse was tricked into meeting his erstwhile children, now in service of Annihilation, who nearly killed him. Seeking to stop the conflict erupting on her lands, Saturnyne, the ruler of Otherworld, intervened and forced the two sides into a ceasefire. She offered to host a tournament wherein the champions of Arakko and Krakoa would face each other in a tournament to settle the matter. Genesis had the Horsemen recruit their champions, and led them herself to Otherworld. thumb|left|Annihilation unmasked After confronting Saturnyne in the Starlight Citadel, Apocalypse, who led the Krakoan champions, would encounter

genevieve.name: Genevieve
genevieve.origin: Genevieve was a mutant, born with telekinetic powers. Distressed by these unwanted powers, she began to work for Herbert Landon at the Brand Corporation, believing he was working on a cure for mutancy. At Landon's press conference, the Hobgoblin attacked the building and caused the roof to cave in. Spider-Man, who arrived to try and stop Hobgoblin, was saved when Genevieve used her telekinetic powers to stop the roof from collapsing on him. It later turned out that Landon's real intention was to create a serum to destroy all mutants, and Genevieve accepted that this was the best way to end the incurable disease. When a chain of events resulted in Landon mutating into a monstrous creature feeding on electricity, Genevieve saved Spider-Man once again as well as the X-Men by preventing their ship from crashing while they were trying to stop Landon. She realized her mistake with her involvement with Landon, since it only gotten worse. Beast revealed that he had suspected her mutancy for some time, and told her that he would introduce her to Professor Charles Xavier, who would help her to accept her mutant condition.

genevieve cross.name: Genevieve Cross
genevieve cross.origin: Genevieve had recently run out on her boyfriend, taken his motorcycle and rode and rode as far from Brixton as she could (as he was a 'Big Man' there). Seeming at random she stopped in the hills of central Wales to answer the call of nature, only to accidently stepped into a deer trap and was then happened upon by Dr. Strange disguised as Dr. Stephen Sanders. In reality she like four others (Dafydd ap Iowerth, Roger Loomis, Sian Bowen, Will Fanshawe) were drawn there to serve as host bodies for the spirits of the New Defenders (Valkyrie, Interloper, Andromeda, and Manslaughter) who were being returned from the dead by The Vishanti. During the Atlantis Rising storyline, when Andromeda is stabbed in the back by the Ebony Blade, her soul becomes trapped within the weapon. This allows Genevieve's soul to take control of their shared body, momentarily reverting it to her original form. However, this transformation lasts only a few moments before the body shifts back to Andromeda's Atlantean form. While Namor battled Morgan le Fay, Triton, and Bloodwraith, Genevieve—still in Andromeda's form—was disoriented, struggling to breathe air in a body that required water. As the fight raged on, Namor occasionally pushed her head underwater to keep her from suffocating. Once the battle ended, a wounded Namor led her back to Atlantis, where Raman and Vashti ensured they both received medical care. Though stabilized, Genevieve remained confused and unable to speak, struggling to adjust to her new reality.

genis vell.origin: ===Origins=== After a falling out with Captain America, Rick Jones found himself mentally drawn to a pair of extraterrestrial golden bracelets: the Nega-Bands. Donning the bands, Rick slammed his wrists together with all his might and his atoms traded places with those of the exiled Kree, Captain Mar-Vell. Joined together, Rick and Captain Marvel lived a shared existence. During the epic Kree-Skrull War, Rick and Captain Marvel became pawns of the Kree Supreme Intelligence who unleashed the untapped psionic potential of Rick's mind - the Destiny Force - to put an end to the war. Sometime later, however, tragedy struck as Captain Mar-Vell perished from incurable systemic cancer. 180px|thumb|left|Bidding farewell to his mother While Rick moved on with his life, Mar-Vell's love, Elysius, felt more alone than ever. Using Titanian science, Elysius sampled some of Mar-Vell's genetic structure to conceive a child: Genis. To protect him from Captain Marvel's enemies, Elysius had Genis artificially aged to maturity and then took him to an isolated world called Paraxis. There, they lived peacefully, safe from harm, with occasional visits from Eros, who Genis believed to be his father. When he was old enough, Genis left the planet and led a normal life until the day his mother told him the truth about his true lineage and gifted him the Nega-Bands worn by his father. After that, he was determined to carry on his father's heroic tradition as Legacy, eventually changing to Captain Marvel. Early in his tenure carrying his father's title, Elysius was killed by the villainous Syphonn. ===Bound to Rick Jones=== When Rick's Destiny powers resurfaced, he became a pawn in a time-spanning conflict known as the Destiny War. At the climax of the War, Captain Marvel found himself unwillingly merged with Jones, much like his father, a process which triggered his latent Cosmic Awareness. During this time, while one of them remained on Earth, or Earth's dimension, the other was stuck in the Microverse (although they initially thought they were in the Negative Zone, as it had happened with Genis' father). The duo could communicate and see through each other's eyes and, to change places, the person on Earth simply had to bang the nega-bands together. 180px|thumb|right|Guided by Rick Jones At first, the Cosmic Awareness proved very troublesome, as both Rick and Genis would see things before they happened, scaring all the bystanders, who were still not seeing any sort of danger, but they soon realized what was happening and managed to use it for their advantage a few of times. Still, Genis wasn't completely in tune with his abilities, so he accepted the help of Moondragon in handling this issue. During this time, Genis also had a dream come true, after shortly meeting an alternate version of Mar-Vell and being able to hug his father for the very first time. Genis' next threat came in the form of Una and Zey-Rogg, the children of Yon-Rogg, Mar-Vell's greatest adversary and thought-to-be victim. They engaged Genis in battle, but both came out defeated, with Zey ending up with severe injuries in the Microverse and Una being taken by the Kree Bloodhounds, who hunted down any Kree women who had escaped the procedures to remove their psychic abilities. 180px|thumb|left|Under Una-Rogg's spell Rick's wife Marlo and Moondragon then tried to convince Genis to help Una, but he didn't feel like saving someone who had tried to kill him. Nevertheless, the two did meet again, when Genis traveled to Hala to seek the Supreme Intelligence's help in restoring Rick Jones youth, after he had been prematurely aged by a death god. The moment Genis got there, he was thrown in a cell with Una-Rogg, who had already gone through the first phase of procedures and been stripped of her powers. Together, they were then sent by the Supreme Intelligence to retrieve rare radiation from a sun within the Negative Zone to heal Rick Jones. Una cheered Genis while he fought Burstarr, who then almost killed her. In the end, they managed to get what they sought, and, although Rick wasn't successfully cured, Una and Genis were allowed to leave unharmed. In time, Rick regained his youth through mysterious ways. ===Insane=== Now in tune with his cosmic awareness, Genis began to go insane under the strain of his powers after discovering the inherent difficulty in choosing who to help and who to let die. Overwhelmed, he fell into a catatonic state that lasted a long time, while Jones remained stuck in the Microverse. When Rick finally asked him what his father would have thought, Genis snapped out of it and left to meet with the Punisher, who he asked to teach him 'discipline' and single-mindedness. 180px|thumb|right|New Uniform Ignoring Rick, Genis stayed with Castle for a while, before venturing to the planet Toped, where he conquered its people to use them as an experiment before moving onto something on a larger scale. genji odashu.name: Genji Odashu
genji odashu.origin: Genji Odashu was a pilot recruited against her will by the Followers of the Light to pilot the Shogun Warrior robot Combatra. She did this for several months, battling various menaces to Earth until Combatra was destroyed, after which she returned to her former occupation. During her time as a pilot of Combatra she risked her life to protect a group of civilians from an explosive by placing her robot over the explosive train car, knocking her out temporarily. However she survived and was ultimately able to defeat her enemies She was briefly a member of the Avengers' support staff.

gennady gavrilov.name: Gennady Gavrilov
gennady gavrilov.species: Human who used Anton Vanko's lost prototype Crimson Dynamo Armor Mark II
gennady gavrilov.origin: Gennady Gravilov (Russian: Геннадий Дмитриевич Гаврилов) was a bright student, but had a habit of taking and hiding items. He was almost expelled from school for taking batteries. thumb|left|160px Gennady also spent most of his time on the Internet messaging a "cajun angel." While working at Moscow State University, transporting boxes of paperworks from warehouses, Gennady came across a helmet from a prototype Crimson Dynamo armor made by the late Anton Vanko. He accidentally triggered the armor's activation via the helmet's remote control and homing mode. The armor went on a rampage throughout Russia in its attempt to get itself to the helmet while Gennady initial believed the helmet to be a virtual reality gaming system. Gennady learned from Vanko's notes that the armor builds an massive electromagnetic charge. Without special gauntlets, it would overload. Gennady was pursued by the rogue spy Alexandre Deveraux as well as the russian military who were all after the armor. With the help of Wayne Jennings, an arms inspector, Gennady was able to stop the armor. Anthony Stark offered his technical assistance if needed. Gennady managed to escape from the military with the armor via a railway using the armors maglev system. Gennady then hid the armor in basement of his stepfather's warehouse, stating an intention to become a superhero and unaware that Tony Stark still maintained a remote kill switch for the armor should he ever decide to shut Gennady down.

gennady markov.name: Gennady Markov
gennady markov.first_appearance: Marvel's The Avengers: Black Widow Strikes Vol 1 2
gennady markov.origin: Gennady Markov was a S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent undercover, posing as one of Yuri Klementiev's bodyguards. He was Black Widow's contact who had snuck onto Klementiev's yacht during a reception posing as model "Marya Konn". Markov had Widow identify General Starodoub, Klementiev's partner in arms trafficking, and an Iranian, Mohammed Yavari, who was posing as a Tehran businessman but was actually a secret agent of the Vaja, the Iranian intelligence, and who was probably the bootleg Starktech buyer that Starodoub was trying to place. After Widow managed to recover the stolen technology, she found Gennady held hostage by Sofia who forced Widow to hand it over to her, only for Sofia to shoot Gennady in the head, killing him, and then flee.

genome.name: Genome
genome.species: Virus created by the Ani-Mator to replicate himself, imperfect and mutated (Mutant)
genome.origin: Following a nightmare involving the Ani-Mator, Doug Ramsey asked his fellow New Mutants to return to Paradise Island , the place where he died. Once there, they found only residues of organic masses of the Ani-Mates and were immediately attacked by Bird-Brain. Once Bird-Brain had been subdued, Warlock communicated that their former ally had been infected by the Virusplague and that during the battle all the members of the New Mutants had been infected and Warlock forced them to quarantine. Cypher and Warlock manage to remove the Ani-Mator's influence from the virus, leaving it a benevolent presence. Doug renamed it "Genome".

genrami.name: Genrami
genrami.origin: Genrami was an Indian mirror maker who was loyal to the Imperial Japanese during World War II. Late in the war, he discovered a rare mineral known as Trilite, which would cause blindness in those who looked at it. Using Trilite in his Myriad of Mirrors attraction, he admitted American soldiers with the purpose of them going blind in the battle field. When this proved to be a success, he then began creating mirror sculptures which he intended to sell to American soldiers camped outside of town to strike more blind. However, as he was preparing for this second sneak attack, Captain America and Bucky became wise to his operation and went to confront him. Genrami had his men overpower the heroes and had them locked in an air tight room surrounded with Trilite mirrors, mockingly leaving them some papers to read before going off to sell his hazardous wares to the soldiers. However, Captain America and Bucky soon freed themselves, and after obtaining a black light projector that could cure those blinded by Trilite, they rushed off to stop Genrami. Fleeing, Genrami attempted to blind Captain America with a stronger Trilite mirror. However, Cap tackled his foe, knocking out Genrami's protective contact lenses. Looking into his own mirror, Genrami was instantly blinded and fell off a cliff to his death. Captain America and Bucky then used the black light projector to cure all his victims.

Using Trilite in his Myriad of Mirrors attraction, he admitted American soldiers with the purpose of them going blind in the battle field. When this proved to be a success, he then began creating mirror sculptures which he intended to sell to American soldiers camped outside of town to strike more blind. However, as he was preparing for this second sneak attack, Captain America and Bucky became wise to his operation and went to confront him. Genrami had his men overpower the heroes and had them locked in an air tight room surrounded with Trilite mirrors, mockingly leaving them some papers to read before going off to sell his hazardous wares to the soldiers. However, Captain America and Bucky soon freed themselves, and after obtaining a black light projector that could cure those blinded by Trilite, they rushed off to stop Genrami. Fleeing, Genrami attempted to blind Captain America with a stronger Trilite mirror. However, Cap tackled his foe, knocking out Genrami's protective contact lenses. Looking into his own mirror, Genrami was instantly blinded and fell off a cliff to his death. Captain America and Bucky then used the black light projector to cure all his victims.
equipment: Genrami had special contacts that filtered out the blinding effects of Trilite, and also had a black light projector that could cure Trilite's effects in case of accidental blindness.

geoff monte.origin: Geoff Monte worked as a bank manager. When the bank was attacked by Adahm and his Goon-Squad, Monte lost consciousness. After Batroc defeated the criminals (for a fee of $10,000 offered by Geoff's wife, Rhonda), Geoff tried to take credit in the media, saying that Batroc had merely helped. Batroc was none too pleased about this and embarrassed him on live TV by dumping a trash can over his head and returned the money.

geoffrey ballard.name: Geoffrey Ballard
geoffrey ballard.origin: Geoffrey Ballard was a government official who was sent to Star International as a security official overviewing a project that was sent to Los Angeles in a box. When the box was stolen, he forbade Tony Stark to inform his LA employee Bill Foster about the box's contents. Later, he started working together with the mutant Mystique, they stole a prototype armor and weapon named Centurion from a heavily secured armory on the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier. He then took the name Centurion for himself. Ballard had been stalking Ms. Marvel for some time prior to this once even breaking into her apartment and her office at Woman Magazine. With his new suit and alias, he battled Ms. Marvel and the Avengers across New York. He was eventually defeated and was unmasked revealing his true identity, which prompted the Avengers to question their own and S.H.I.E.L.D.'s security. His current whereabouts are unknown.

geoffrey barnett.name: Geoffrey Barnett
geoffrey barnett.origin: Geoffrey Barnett was a mobster who hired chemist Dwight Faron to make designer drugs for him. When Barnett learned the police were investigating him, he set up Faron to take fall for his crimes by ensuring Spider-Man found his drug lab and apprehended Faron. Faron spent five years in prison, and after being released, he vowed vengeance. After enhancing his physical abilities with a specially made serum, Faron impersonated Spider-Man and brutally attacked criminals to lure Spider-Man in a trap so he could kill the hero. When Faron found Barnett, he forced Barnett to participate in his plan. Barnett and his men planned to kill Faron or Spider-Man in an ambush, but they were instead killed by the Punisher.

geoffrey crawford.origin: Geoffrey Crawford was a professor of physics at Desert State University in Navapo, New Mexico. Crawford devoted years to develop and built a two-pod teleportation device called Telepod System: Subjects would enter the first pod. The system would then scan the occupant's matter, turn it into energy, then transmit the energy to a second, receptor pod, where it would be restored to its original form, including post-birth modifications. Crawford, a fan of TV show Star Trek, claimed to have been influenced by it to create the system; thou it took him long years to create. At one point, Crawford was one of the physics professors of DSU star student Bruce Banner, also becoming his mentor, inspiration and one of his favorite teachers; in turn, Banner was Crawford's favorite student. After Banner finished his studies, he and Crawford lost contact. Crawford began to suffer a debilitating neuromuscular disease that left him wheelchair-ridden, every passing day his movements being slightly harder. The disease would eventually affect Crawford so much that he would be unable to work, yet he insisted on working for as long as he could, also trying to not let his condition to be widely known. Banner did hear Crawford was sick, but did not imagine the extent. After several years, Banner suffered a mutation that turned him into the monstrous Hulk. Desperate to find a cure, he sought help from experts like Crawford. When Banner approached Crawford, he was surprised to find Crawford in a wheelchair, and considered not bothering him; Crawford insisted and showed him his Telepod System, which he had tested on rats. Crawford proposed mapping Banner's body chemistry, comparing it to a normal human and filtering out Gamma mutations from his DNA, before reconstructing him in the second pod. After some preliminary scans of Banner, they stopped for the night, and Crawford insisted on hosting Banner at his home. Crawford however planned to install Banner's gamma mutations within his own body, to cure himself, as Hulk famously had an important regenerative power. During the night, Crawford snuck back to the lab and Banner stealthily followed him. So as to avoid interference when he was his own Guinea pig, Crawford programmed a fail-safe in the computer controlling the pods, so that the process could not be stopped. Banner found Crawford submitting himself to the process, but was helpless and the stress turned him into the Hulk. Crawford emerged from the pod as a savage, power-hungry monster, thou far more intelligent that the Hulk at the time. Calling himself Ravage, Crawford confronted the Hulk, believing that Banner had intentionally tried to keep Hulk's powers for himself. Their fight was seen from the students' dorms, and the students phoned Gamma Base to notify the Hulkbusters of a Hulk sighting. Ravage broke the Hulk's neck, then fled - but at sunrise, Ravage returned to his human form as Crawford, with useless legs. Banner found Crawford, helped him to his home, and theorized that the change was the same effect Banner experienced after he was first transformed; transforming to human during the day. Banner tried to convince Crawford to revert the process because Ravage was a threat to anyone around him; but Crawford, unwilling to stay as a disabled sick man with running-out time, instead wanted to continue the experiments to correct the problems and stay as Ravage even during the day. Gamma Bases' General Ross and Major Talbot arrived at Desert State University after the monsters had left, but after checking Crawford's lab, they tracked the destruction to Crawford's home. Crawford arranged for Banner to be captured by Ross and Talbot, to keep him away from his plans; Banner was arrested. The following night, Ravage reappeared on a spree of destruction, mad with power, destroying everything in Navapo including buildings, cars and street furniture; the locals, believing him to be Hulk, tried to escape from him. The Hulkbusters sent military troops and equipment against him, but were unable to stop him. Meanwhile, General Ross confirmed that Banner was still imprisoned at Gamma Base, and questioned him about this second Hulk; Banner revealed that Ravage was Crawford, and asked to go to Crawford's laboratory to stop him. Ross begrudgingly accepted. Banner's plan was to apprehend Crawford in his vulnerable, human form; then place him in the pods, where Banner would be able to revert the process and restore Crawford's original DNA. However, Ravage noticed intruders entering his lab, and went to check, finding Banner and Ross. Correctly assuming they intended to use the pods against him, Ravage destroyed them; Banner reminded him of his weak Crawford form, but Crawford claimed to have already corrected that while Banner was imprisoned. Enraged, Banner became the Hulk and fought Ravage at Crawford's lab. The lab crumbled on their heads, but Hulk saved General Ross. Ravage burst from the wreckage to find Major Talbot waiting for him, with

geoffrey sydenham.name: Geoffrey Sydenham
geoffrey sydenham.origin: left|thumb|Geoffrey Sydenham in 1941 In 1941, Captain America, Logan, Ivan Petrovich, and Natasha Alianovna asked ambassador Geoffrey Sydenham for help, but he was actually a traitor who was allied with Baron Strucker. He took them as prisoners, believing the true destiny of the United States was to join with Germany in an Aryan hegemony against communism. He was eventually defeated and went to jail on charges of treason and sedition. While in prison he was approached by Dormammu who agreed to teach him the dark arts. Dormammu convinced Sydenham that it was more useful to recruit enemies to work for him in his greater struggle against communist Russia. As such, when he was released, Sydenham began recruiting former Nazi operatives into his new organization ICON. To this end, he recruited such Nazi superhumans as Baron Blood, Brain Drain, the Ubermadchen, and many others to put his plan into action. He managed to get the backing of American Senator Sanford, who agreed with Sydenham about the threat of Russia to the American way of life. The undersecretary also tried to assassinate Nick Fury's Avengers, but they all managed to survive. Sydenham also kidnapped T'Chaka, the ruler of the secret African nation of Wakanda, in order to ensure that country's compliance in the upcoming war. He later sent his ICON operatives to the technologically advanced nation in an attempt to pillage its futuristic technology to use in their war against the Russians. This plan was foiled, however, by the Avengers. Sydenham was finally defeated when the Avengers teleported to Washington, D.C. and soundly beat the last of his super-powered followers. Powell McTeague then ensnared a fleeing Sydenham in mystical chains and turned him over to the authorities. He was soon released by a government sub-committee headed by Senator Sanford who opted not to prosecute him in exchange for him revealing the location of T'Chaka. Sydenham was last seen in Greenwich Village again using his black magic for some unspecified purpose. His subsequent activities are as yet unrevealed.

fields.history: left|thumb|Geoffrey Sydenham in 1941 In 1941, Captain America, Logan, Ivan Petrovich, and Natasha Alianovna asked ambassador Geoffrey Sydenham for help, but he was actually a traitor who was allied with Baron Strucker. He took them as prisoners, believing the true destiny of the United States was to join with Germany in an Aryan hegemony against communism. He was eventually defeated and went to jail on charges of treason and sedition. While in prison he was approached by Dormammu who agreed to teach him the dark arts. Dormammu convinced Sydenham that it was more useful to recruit enemies to work for him in his greater struggle against communist Russia. As such, when he was released, Sydenham began recruiting former Nazi operatives into his new organization ICON. To this end, he recruited such Nazi superhumans as Baron Blood, Brain Drain, the Ubermadchen, and many others to put his plan into action. He managed to get the backing of American Senator Sanford, who agreed with Sydenham about the threat of Russia to the American way of life. The undersecretary also tried to assassinate Nick Fury's Avengers, but they all managed to survive. Sydenham also kidnapped T'Chaka, the ruler of the secret African nation of Wakanda, in order to ensure that country's compliance in the upcoming war. He later sent his ICON operatives to the technologically advanced nation in an attempt to pillage its futuristic technology to use in their war against the Russians. This plan was foiled, however, by the Avengers. Sydenham was finally defeated when the Avengers teleported to Washington, D.C. and soundly beat the last of his super-powered followers. geoffrey vandergill.name: Geoffrey Vandergill
geoffrey vandergill.origin: Geoffrey Vandergill lived in the New York City during World War II and joined Captain America's Sentinels of Liberty youth group. He met Captain America's sidekick Bucky and become part of the Young Allies a group of wartime youths who would work to fight Nazi spies and other menaces to America during World War II. ===Pre-Face: Truth and Fiction=== It has been revealed that a lot of the Young Allies wartime adventures were made into a comic book as propaganda for the United States to earn support in the war effort, especially among young impressionable people. The comic book, while based on true events, were often times embellished and sensationalized. Further, to "protect" the identities of the Young Allies (however, in later years, Bucky would suspect it was to avoid having to pay out royalties for the use of their likenesses), they were all portrayed as caricatures of themselves, and young adolescents around the age of 12, while in real life they were in their late teens to early adulthood and eventually became old enough to enlist in the military and see action in the battle field. In these comics Geoffrey was portrayed as "Jeff", the brains of the group. Geoff appeared to have no problem with his depiction in these stories. The fictional accounts of the Young Allies are the most complete record of their activities during World War II, however how much of these tales are fiction and how much are truth have yet to be completely chronicled. For the purposes of clarity between what is known to be fully factual and what is regarded as sensationalized fiction, both will be addressed separately in this profile. ===Real Life History=== Shortly after the formation of the Young Allies, Geoff joined his comrades in smashing a Nazi spy ring in New York leading to a clash with the Red Skull. The youths would be assisted by the timely arrival of Captain America and the Human Torch. In 1943, Jeff and the Young Allies were sent to Hollywood California for a war bond drive. The rally was soon marred by an panic caused by Bucky and Toro's foe Lady Lotus, and they soon broke up the panic. Jeff and his friends were then ordered by the military to report to Democracy Pictures to participate in a film that was in support of the war. They were once more targeted by Lady Lotus who hypnotized actors to attack them, and then took Toro under her control. Capturing the team, Lady Lotus hypnotized the rest of the group and as part of her plan to take over the American west coast sent the group in a B-17 and P-40 to attack Muroc Army Airfield. However, Washington Jones snapped out of Lady Lotus' control and managed to help the others break free from her mind control. They got the air field's participation in a ruse that made it appear their attack was a success. Pretending to still be under the control of Lady Lotus, the Young Allies got close enough to attack her. During the battle, Toro managed to knock a crystal that Lotus was using to boost her powers and it was subsequently swallowed up by the Earth. Lady Lotus then fled, vowing to get revenge against the Young Allies someday. Coming of age, Geoff and his fellow Young Ally Henry Tinkelbaum became members of the Office of Strategic Services (the wartime precursor to the CIA). In 1944, Geoff reunited with his fellow Young Allies when they all had some downtime. Meeting in France, the Young Allies had their festivities cut short when Geoff spotted German operative Hauptman Kleinschmidt. With himself and Henry using their spy skills to pose as the operatives that Kleinschmidt and his minions were waiting to report to, they provided ample distraction for the rest of the Young Allies to ambush the spies, leading to Kleinschmidt's ultimate death. This was the last time the Young Allies would fight together, but they all stayed in touch over the years. ===Fictional History=== thumb|left|"Jeff" circa 1941 For a detailed account of the fictional history of Jeff Vandergill see the Fictional History of the Young Allies. ===After the War=== After the war, Geoffrey remained with the OSS and was active after it became the CIA. He continued to serve his country until he was reported as killed in action fighting in Indochina (modern day Vietnam). His body was buried in Arlington National Cemetery in Arlington, Virginia.

geoffrey wickshire.name: Geoffrey Wickshire
geoffrey wickshire.origin: Geoffrey and his step-brother Edmund, owned an estate out on the moor, but Edmund wished to destroy his blind brother, so he could have all the estate. He pretended to show good will to Geoffrey and offered to take him out for a walk onto the moor. He led him to a pit of quicksand and then shouted about running off some poachers and left his brother alone. When Geoffrey stumbled into the quicksand, Edmund was overjoyed and went back to the house. That evening, he felt guilty and cannot sleep. He thought to hears a noise upon the stairs. To his horror, the door opened, and a thing covered in wet sand slowly advanced upon him. He backed away, towards the open window. It turned out that Geoffrey was rescued by Leprechauns that lived under the bog, and they offered to repair his sight if he would have stayed with them for a week. He was overjoyed and wished to tell his brother that, once his sight was repaired, he would do what he had always wanted to do and go out to sea. This meant that Edmund will get the full estate. He was puzzled when his brother doesn't responded. Even though Edmund got what he wanted, he didn't get to enjoy it. Since he was so terrified by what he took to be his brother's corpse seeking revenge, he backed away too far, falling through an open window and into the courtyard below.

geoffrey wilder.name: Geoffrey Wilder
geoffrey wilder.origin: 300px|thumb|left|Geoffrey and Catherine Wilder (Earth-616)|Catherine Wilder escaping after a robbery ===Origins=== Geoffrey Wilder was a small-time thief living in Los Angeles when he and Catherine eloped against her mother's wishes. ===The Pride=== While escaping after a robbery, the couple was summoned by the Gibborim to be the "The Thieves" in the Pride with promises of power, wealth, and eternal life. Geoffrey then became the leader of the Pride. left|thumb|200px|Geoffrey presiding over Pride (Earth-616)|the Pride As the leader of the Pride, Geoffrey used his influence, wealth, connections, and strategic prowess to rule the Los Angeles underworld, sacrificing to the Gibborim, protecting his turf, and disposing of threats to his power for a quarter of a century. right|thumb|200px|Young Geoffrey being pulled into the present by the Pride (Earth-616)|New Pride ===The New Pride=== Depressed after finding out about Alex Wilder's death, his friends from his online MMORPG began planning to bring him back. Together they researched the Pride and used the Abstract to cast a spell to retrieve Alex from the past before he died. During the ceremony, Oscar died and a young Geoffrey Wilder was summoned to the present instead of Alex. To gather more information about the Runaways, Geoffrey posed as Chamber using the Minorus' Chameleon Glamour Charm and joined a rival group of teen superheroes called Excelsior. Once the New Pride had gathered enough information, they directly confronted the Runaways and kidnapped Molly Hayes. Geoffrey offered to sacrifice Molly's soul to the Gibborim if they promised to reunite him with his wife. During the rescue, Geoffrey seemingly murdered Gertrude Yorkes. Furious, the Runaways captured Geoffrey, erased his memory, and sent him back to the past to avoid further impact on the timeline. ===Runaways and Death=== Although Geoffrey loved and was fiercely protective of his son, he often had difficulty communicating with him. right|thumb|300px| After the the children of the Pride witnessed the Pride murder a young woman during the "Rite of Blood", they decided to run away from their parents. With their children on the run, Geoffrey and the Pride used their connection with the L.A.P.D. to find their children. Geoffrey framed Alex Wilder, Nico Minoru and Gertrude Yorkes for the murder of Destiny Gonzales and kidnapping of Molly Hayes. Karolina Dean and Chase Stein were specifically left out of the frame job to prevent anyone from connecting all the members of the Pride. Geoffrey continued to monitor for new of the children and press contacts for any possible news. Geoffrey and Catherine died in the Marine Vivarium with the other members of the Pride during the failed Rite of Thunder.

geomancer china.name: Geomancer (China)
geomancer china.origin: Dei Guan was an orphan in China after his parents were killed for being considered dissidents. Dei was sent to a re-education camp and later was forced into labour in a mine. It was during one of his shifts in the iron mine that the mysterious Geomancer appeared and told Dei Guan that their ancestors believed that "Dragons of Jade" lived beneath the earth and lent their powers to great warriors. He then imparted to Dei Guan the power of the Jade Dragon, allowing him to change into a massive dragon form.

geometer.name: Geometer
geometer.origin: Geometer was a member of an unknown, long extinct alien race of scientists. He believed he had discovered a mathematical equation that fully described the workings of the universe, but another of his race made a physical observation his equation had not accounted for. Annoyed, Geometer left to find a universe that did fit and discovered the Lathe of Perfection that allowed him to change anything into perfect geometries. He spent billions of years traveling to different universes, where he discovered a man from his native reality. He tried to use the Lathe on him, but the man escaped through another rift before the process was complete. The Geometer then followed him back to his home reality, and come into conflict with Quasar. The Geometer tried to remake this universe, but Quasar was able to convince him that too many imperfections existed for this to work and instead should travel back in time to the beginning of the universe. Quasar expected that this would create a divergent timeline if the Geometer survived. His fate after this is unknown, but the Geometer or another of his race was present during the Maximum Security crisis.

george ailen.name: George Ailen
george ailen.origin: Prof. George Ailen was the United States' top geologist. His instruments detected lifeforms that lived deep below the Earth's surface and tried to warn everyone about these lifeforms, but no one believed him. Ailen was eventually proven correct when two Stone Men emerged from the ground in Times Square and started to rampage. Ailen was accused by an angry mob of being in league with the Stone Men. Ailen refuted the claim and also argued that the Stone Men were harmless as they hadn't hurt anyone during their rampage. Ailen was able to convince the U.S. Army to stop attacking the Stone Men and leave them be. The Stone Men eventually returned to their home deep belowground. When the Army expressed concern that more Stone Men would come to attack, Ailen assured them that they had nothing to worry about because the Stone Men were adapted to living deep belowground and thus couldn't sense anything on the Earth's surface and that the Stone Men that appeared were merely exploring.

george amplas.origin: George Amplas liked going to Dracula movies and biting audience members on the neck. When he goes home, he is shadowed by a mystery man who claims to be a "student of the occult." At home, he attempts to suck the blood from the family cat, leading his father to beat him with a belt. When George's own blood runs into his mouth, he suddenly transforms into a genuine vampire and kills his parents. The mysterious stranger then enters and transforms into a vampire, revealing himself as our hero's real father!

george baker.name: George Baker
george baker.origin: George Baker, or D.O.A. as he is better known, is a mutated human created by his master, Emplate. He works as his loyal butler and valet, but other than that, not much is known about him. When Emplate was still determined to find Penance, he formed a team of mutants, that due to their status as Emplate's Hellions, D.O.A. joined and worked for his master to hunt down the missing mutant girl. During the battle with Generation X, the team was defeated, but Emplate and D.O.A. managed escape. D.O.A. was the lone, loyal servant of his master when they captured Bling!. The young mutant tried to escape by using her powers to release diamond shards, and one of them struck D.O.A. in the head, but due to his mysterious powers, he survived. After Rogue's intervention, however, Bling! was rescued and D.O.A. was cast with Emplate back to their dimension. After Emplate possessed Monet, she settled down in an abandoned subway car beneath Central Park. At that point, D.O.A. was back serving his master and would regularly capture Morlocks for them to feed on.

george blair.name: George Blair
george blair.origin: Gorgeous George was a member of the Nasty Boys, a group of young mutants whose first and only missions were against the government sponsored X-Factor. He retained his mutant powers after the events of M-Day and, together with Slab and Hairbag, opened a lab for MGH's production. When the Upstarts resurfaced, George and the other Nasty Boys were killed only to be used as bait to lure out the X-Men. ===Krakoa=== Gorgeous George was later one of the many mutants who resurfaced on the mutant island of Krakoa. While attending a party at the Green Lagoon, Black Tom Cassidy stumbled into George. George ridiculed Black Tom's role on Krakoa and started a fight. Sage joined in the brawl, defending Black Tom from Gorgeous George. ===X-Force=== After the Krakoa era, Gorgeous George rejoined the Nasty Boys under Mister Sinister again but he and the others disintegrated while fighting X-Force. However, Archangel in his new Blood Angel persona resurrected him and the Nasty Boys to give them a chance of redemption and freed them from Sinister's control.

george brinner.name: George Brinner
george brinner.origin: George Brinner found a wealthy deposit of bauxite in the mountains of the an unspecified southern state on the properties of the Rand and Coger families. Learning that the two clans have been feuding for years, Brinner attempted to exacerbate things further, while appearing to be a friendly neighbor. After Lee Coger and Jonce Rand were drafted into the U.S. Military and stationed at Camp Lehigh, Brinner sent Lee a letter warning him that Rand was going to play a trick on him. When the two southerners began to fight, that fight was intercepted by Private Steve Rogers and camp mascot James Buchanan Barnes (secretly Captain America and Bucky). When Bucky was forced to defend himself against Jonce Rand, Brinner secretly stabbed Rand in the back, framing Bucky for the murder. Posing as a military police officer, Brinner pulled a gun on the men gathered at the scene. However, Lee noticed that Brinner's pistol was not military issue and jumped him before fleeing the scene along with Steve Rogers. Brinner also fled while the military arrested Bucky. Knowing that Lee would go and warn the rest of the Coger family, Brinner followed him south and killed Lee before he could warn his family -- who was already prepared to attack the Rands thanks to radio coverage of the murder. When Captain America arrived to try and talk the Rands and Coger out of feuding, Brinner attempted to kill Colonel Rand, convincing the patriarch to have Captain America held at gun point while the rest of the Rands went to go meet the Cogers. Brinner's undoing came when he stopped in his plan to charm Drusilla Rand, who was charged with guarding Captain America, allowing Cap to escape. Convinced that the Rand and Coger families would slay each other, Brinner ventured to a nearby telephone box to call the authorities only to be caught red handed by Captain America. During their struggle, Brinner succeeded in gaining the upper hand by throwing Cap off a nearby cliff. Brinner then went to gather his gang to prepare to eliminate any survivors of the clash. Captain America and Bucky arrived and broke up the gang, but Brinner fled. Cap brought the captured gang and had them confess the whole plot to both families, finally bringing them to peace. Seeing this, Brinner attempted to slay the patriarchs of both families, only to be stopped by Captain America and Bucky. With his plot ruined, Brinner was turned over to the authorities.

george chelm.name: George Chelm
george chelm.origin: A police inspector with the Scotland Yard, Inspector George Chelm interrogated Frank Drake, Rachel van Helsing, and Taj Nitall on the scene where Dracula had killed a night porter in order to regain his coffin. Initially not believing the group's story that it was done by a vampire, he was convinced when the porter rose as a vampire. Since then, Inspector Chelm has remained a supporter of this group of vampire hunters and helped provide them with information and support from Scotland Yard in trying to rid London of the scourge of Dracula.

Together with the Black King Sir Patrick Clemens, Black Queen Lady Jean Grey, and Red Queen Lady Diana Knight, the four formed the Club's first Inner Circle. They meddled in the American Revolutionary War, and tried to assure the victory of the Kingdom of Great Britain. To achieve their goals, they came to Philadelphia, where they hoped to control Major General Wallace Worthington and get Thirteen Colonies' military secrets from him, but their plan failed.

To achieve their goals, they came to Philadelphia, where they hoped to control Major General Wallace Worthington and get Thirteen Colonies' military secrets from him, but their plan failed.
fields.notes: It is unknown if Clinton was a member of the Hellfire Club in Britain like Sir Clemens and Lady Knight, or only joined the American branch after it was established. It is possible that George Clinton is based upon the Revolutionary War commander of the same name.

There, George finds a group of giant bats, and he talks to them about his worrying urges to drink human blood. When his parents learn that he is conflicted over this, they put him in chains and throw him in the basement--because Sverna is a vampire village, and it wouldn't do for a respectable family to have a half-human son!

george harrison skrull.name: George Harrison (Skrull)

The faux-Beatles were intended to take the place of the real Beatles, and use their positions to launch a Skrull invasion. John, however, thought the Skrull Beatles could do more than an alien invasion, and convinced their bosses to give them free reign. Much like the real Beatles, the Skrull Beatles eventually found their interests leading in different directions, leading to the band's break-up. They were all later revealed to be killed, save for John, who died later.

george hatherly.name: George Hatherly
george hatherly.origin: In 1954 Nick Fury was sent to French Indochina to assist the French Army in fighting the communist Viet Minh. He met his partner George Hatherly, as well as Shirley DeFabio, the secretary to Congressman McCuskey, and McCuskey himself. While on the assignment Fury and Defabio started to have an affair. When Fury and Hatherly were sent to a French outpost under the command of Major Lallement he was introduced to Sergeant Steinhoff, an ex-SS soldier whom Fury took a dislike to due to his Nazi background. The two got into a fight, but were interrupted by an ambush. They managed to hold back the ambush; however, a second ambush massacred all the French troops at the outpost except Fury and Hatherly who were spared by Letrong Giap.

george hill criminal.name: George Hill (Criminal)
george hill criminal.origin: George Hill was a low level thug who robbed a bank one day. While he and the other two thugs tried to make their escape, they almost hit Aunt May with their getaway car. Enraged, Peter Parker left momentarily to become Spider-Man and chase down the thugs. He caught two of the three thugs, while the third thug, Georgie, escaped into the sewers. Not wanting to spend his afternoon in the dark, dank, odiferous sewer, Spider-Man let George go. While making his way through the New York Sewer System, George stumbled across a secret hideout once belonging to the original Green Goblin, Norman Osborn. Realizing the value of what he found, George contacted Roderick Kingsley, a crooked fashion industry mogul, who had criminal ties to the underworld. Kingsley was very interested in what George had found and had him load all the hideout's contents into a van. After finally emptying the van, Kingsley told George to dispose of the van so it couldn't be traced to them. While driving away, Kingsley detonated an explosive in the van on George, ensuring that all ties to their earlier theft of the Green Goblin hideout would indeed be severed.

george howe.name: George Howe
george howe.origin: As a young man, George Howe served in the United States Army during the Vietnam War. In the summer of 1969, his helicopter crashed near the border near Laos; the Viet-Cong soon arrived, capturing the survivors and taking them back to their base. One by one Howe's comrades were killed, their hands and feet chopped off and tossed into his bamboo cage. When it seemed that his time had come, a Marine Force Recon unit led by Captain Frank Castle attacked the village and rescued Howe. Admiring the special operations personnel for their proficiency, Howe joined the Green Berets for the remainder of the war and was among the first to be recruited into Delta Force. Almost forty years later, Howe was a Colonel in the Army's elite Delta Force. Around this time, he was tasked by a cabal of military generals to arrest Castle, who possessed incriminating evidence on the generals' involvement in Operation Barbarossa. Howe was aware of the smallest details of Barbarossa as his former son-in-law Martin Vanheim was part of the mission along with Castle that resulted in the former's death. Howe was not driven by a desire to avenge Vanheim, however; instead, he was committed to bringing Castle to justice as he felt he was a disgrace to the U.S. military for using his skills he learned in Special Forces to murder thousands in his vigilantism as the Punisher. Upon capturing Castle, Howe learned the truth of Operation Barbarossa from William Rawlins' taped confession. He then allowed Castle to kill the generals by giving him a loaded handgun, and destroys the incriminating evidence out of the belief that if exposed, the U.S. military would lose all sense of credibility.

fields.trivia: It is unusual that despite having served in the Army for over three decades that Howe is still only a Colonel. Thirty years is typically long enough for a real-world officer to reach the rank of General. It's possible, however, that Howe was an enlisted man who gained an officer's commission later in his career; this could explain why he does not hold a higher rank.

george huston.name: George Huston
george huston.origin: George was a playboy and a swindler who duped the girls with his charm and appropriated their money. After receiving the letter from Rona, a desperate girl for not having any more news about the man she loves, Venus goes in search of George and with his powers made George fall in love with her and convinced him to return the stolen goods to the girls he had cheated and definitively leaving the girls telling them all that he had fallen in love with Venus and they would get married. But when George and Venus arrived at Rona's house, they found her sick with little desire to live until she heard George's voice. Rona slips out of her coma until George confesses that he only loves Venus, causing Rona to slip back into her current state. With Rona's situation becoming fatal, Venus quickly teleports back to Olympus where she petitions Jupiter for his help. Jupiter agrees to assist allowing Venus to endow to part of her love power to Rona. Venus invisibly returns to Earth and gives a portion of her power to Rona, who snaps out of her coma. George instantly falls in love with her, curing of her condition.

george maxon.name: George Maxon
george maxon.origin: thumb|left|George Maxon unmasked George Maxon was an American who betrayed his country by joining the Nazi Party. Adolf Hitler offered Maxon a position as minister of all American industry upon a successful takeover of the country by Nazis. Posing as the Red Skull, Maxon sabotaged the very planes he sold to the U.S. Military while also attempting to assassinate key member of the U.S. Military. He became known for having a "look of death", a false hypnotizing killer gaze, which was in reality a poison injected through a hypodermic needle. He used the disbelief in his existence as the Red Skull to his benefit. Maxon's murders attracted the attention of Captain America and Bucky after, as the Skull, Maxon murdered Major Croy. After Maxon succeeded in murdering General Manor, Captain America and Bucky caught up with him. In the ensuing clash, Maxon rolled over onto his own needle of poison and seemingly killed himself. Captain America and Bucky left Maxon to be found by the FBI, with proof of his traitorous activities. Maxon survived and escaped capture. Maxon continued to operate as the Red Skull. Developing a "touch of death" (utilizing a lethal jolt of electricity), he began targeting military officials again. First, he slayed Major Douglas, stealing his plans for a power drill. Using the plans to construct the power drill, Maxon launched an attack on New York City. Seeking out Captain America and Bucky, Maxon instead captured impostors attempting to cash in on the heroes' popularity at a carnival. Maxon hanged the impostors. Believing his enemies to be dead, Maxon was caught off guard when the real Captain America and Bucky arrived. Attempting to escape in his power drill, the Red Skull tossed a bomb at the two heroes. Cap redirected the bomb back at the power drill, destroying it in a powerful explosion and seemingly killing Maxon in the process. When the real Red Skull began to menace Captain America and Bucky, it was revealed that Maxon was merely a pawn posing as the Skull.

george midoro.name: George Midoro
george midoro.origin: George Midoro was a first-class private in the United States Marine Corps who served in the Vietnam War. Following his service in the war, he was transferred to Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni in Iwakuni, Japan. While in Japan, he began to suffer from PTSD and, as a result, went on a drive-by killing spree during the summer. Once he was cornered by the police, he held Yu Komori and his friends hostage and hijacked a plane headed to Osaka. Midoro shot out the landing and altitude controls, hoping that it would force the plane to crash. Luckily for the plane's passengers Komori's subdued Midoro and, as Spider-Man, helped the plane land safely. Upon the plane's landing, Midoro was taken into police custody.

george miller.name: George Miller
george miller.origin: George Miller was a resident of Doverton, Colorado, and the husband of Martha Miller. During Cletus Kasady's takeover of the town, George and Martha were forced to spend time with Kasady on their porch. Kasady complained that he was the only one pushing the swing and ordered Martha to fetch him some lemonade, while George was forced to remain seated in his own mess. Some time after the town had been liberated due to the efforts of Spider-Man, George died due to a heart attack when he was painting his house. When Carnage began tracking down any person who had been infected with a symbiote, dead or alive, to extract their symbiote codex, he exhumated the bodies at the town's cemetery of everybody he had infected and ripped out their spines, including George's.

george mulford.name: George Mulford
george mulford.origin: George Mulford was a ruthless career criminal who was active in the United States during the 1920s. He was arrested after a series of large hold-ups that he committed and was jailed. Breaking out of jail, Mulford stole an experimental spaceship to escape the authorities and soon found himself rocketed off to the planet Venus where he met a race of Venusians who welcomed him with open arms. While on Venus, he taught the people how to speak English and soon became enamored with the woman named Vanza. Learning how to use Venusian technology, Mulford freed a number of criminals from the "Water City" prison, promising them countless riches on Earth once he brought them to America. Forcing Vanza to accompany him and his minions, Mulford used his spaceship to return to Earth. Arriving on the island of Barbuda during the early months of 1945, Mulford and his men used the advanced technology from Venus to slaughter the people of Barbuda and began ransacking the island's wealth. Their murderous attacks attracted the attention of the Sub-Mariner who happened to be vacationing in the area at the time. Namor's attempts to stop the Venusians always came too late, as he failed to stop them from both robbing Barbuda's national bank and kidnapping Billy Steele, the British ambassador's son. Eventually, Namor rescued Vanza, who explained to him how they came to his world and led him to Mulford's secret hideout. There, Mulford's minions captured the pair and Mulford ordered their deaths. Before his men could comply, the Sub-Mariner fought them off and then impaled Mulford on a stalagmite and then set his base to explode, killing all his men and destroying the advanced Venusian technology.

george mullaney.name: George Mullaney
george mullaney.origin: George Mullaney was one of the individuals given paranormal abilities by the White Event, though his were more extreme than most: his entire body began to continually mutate, reconfiguring itself into a completely new form every 24 hours and remaining stable only for the middle 12 hours each time (these mutated forms were rarely human, though usually basically humanoid).He became a patient at the Clinic for Paranormal Research, but had few friends there as most of the other patients were repulsed by his bizarre appearance(s). The one real exception was Jeff Walters who was the only person who was ever actually nice to George. When Walters fled the Clinic, grief stricken at the loss of his family in the destruction of Pittsburgh, George told Walters' friends where he believed he had gone, and stowed away in David Landers' Winnebago when they went after him. Never really accepted by the rest of the group, he was nonetheless later rescued from a group of scavengers by Charlotte Beck, Lenore Fenzl, and Jenny Swensen and remained with them for several days until they were all captured by the Army. Months later, Mullaney recognized Charlotte Beck, whom he'd had a crush on at the Clinic, in New York and, having finally mutated into a handsome human form, approached her, calling himself 'John Mason'. The pair went on a date, but Mullaney eventually left Beck after a pleasant day together, after revealing his true identity to her and telling her that he knew she would be disgusted by him when he began to change again and that his real form wasn't as handsome as John Mason. Later, Mullaney (now in a spider-like form) allowed himself to be cured of his parability by William Wexler, the paranormal called The Cure. Beck, who was present at the time, watched him leave and reflected that his normal form wasn't too bad after all, though he was no John Mason.

george munson.name: George Munson
george munson.origin: thumb|left|110px|George Munson George Munson worked aboard the ship "Golden Boy", which in 1947 sank while carrying a shipment of gold. Munson almost drowned but was saved by Tubby Bates. He and the other survivors, Bates, Al Brown, Jed Tompkins, and Nils all made a pact to go after the jewels once the heat had died down. They all took up other professions in Rivertown until then. However, Munson decided that he wanted the jewels for himself and murdered Nils. He was arrested for the killing and was sentenced to hang. However, he had made a deal with the prison doctor and a guard in exchange for a share of the gold. On his execution night, Munson claimed he was innocent and vowed to come back and get revenge on those responsible for hanging him. Before the execution, the prison doctor threw the fuse box and the guard replaced Munson's body with a corpse, which was hung in his place. Shortly thereafter, Munson -- wearing a ghoulish costume and calling himself the Dead Hangman of Rivertown -- went on a murder spree. He killed the prison doctor, guard, his hangman as well as Jed Tompskins in his quest to claim the jewels entirely for himself. The hanging of Thompson attracted the attention of the nearby Sub-Mariner. When Namor was cutting down Jed's body, Munson knocked him out from behind and attempted to hang him. Namor broke free but Munson managed to escape. Munson decided to taunt the Sub-Mariner by leaving him clues that would lead the hero to the next victim. Munson next killed Al Brown aboard his schooner, and had attack dogs ready to deal with Namor when he arrived on the scene, allowing him to escape again. He left another clue which led Namor to Tubby Bates. After Bates told Namor about the jewels, Munson shot him from afar. Munson then took the neice of Al Brown hostage and with a crew went to salvage the jewels from the Golden Boy. Namor had followed them. Munson then forced Namor to stand down by revealing that he had Ms. Brown as a prisoner. However, when he attempted to hang Namor again, the Sub-Mariner smashed open a porthole, flooding their air tight room. To survive, Munson surrendered and was brought to the surface where his entire plot was revealed. Munson was turned over to the authorities where he was expected to be hung for real this time. However if this was his ultimate fate or not has not been verified.

To survive, Munson surrendered and was brought to the surface where his entire plot was revealed. Munson was turned over to the authorities where he was expected to be hung for real this time. However if this was his ultimate fate or not has not been verified.
equipment: Munson wore a costume that made him appear to be a ghostly apparition. No explanation was provided as to how he succeeded in making a costume that made him appear transparent.
weapons: Munson primarily killed his victims with a noose, but also was armed with a gun.

george patton.name: George Patton
george patton.origin: General George S. Patton retraced his entire military career similarly to that astride his real world counterpart. After the Allied landings in Sicily, he complained to his officers about how Montgomery was handling the situation and how impatient he was to get to Messina and then continue on to Italy to drive out the Nazis and march straight for Germany. At some point, General Patton was summoned by the Martian Kara to the ruins of 30th century New York, where Kara intended to assemble an army of generals and soldiers from history to conquer the Solar System, including Achilles, Hector, Hannibal, Caesar, Alexander the Great, Attila the Hun, Sversky, Allelo, Napoléon, Cromwell, and Lafayette. Instead, the assembled army turned against Kara and killed him, then warned Earth Government of the Martian threat, and offered to help as strategists. Humanity consequently conducted preemptive, genocidal strikes on the cities of Mars, though the time-displaced soldiers were of little use due to their lack of knowledge and understanding of the future surrounding them, and instead mostly watched and tried to learn. After Mars was wiped out, they were awarded a special medal voted by congress. Remaining there for another month to witness the future, they eventually said their goodbyes and faded away, returning to their respective eras, to the moment they had been taken, unbeknownst to all but them. Having realized the vastness of the universe, they all grasped the impossibility of conquering it, and all lost their appetite for war and conquest, explaining why none would conquer the Earth.
